ex.en: She's thinking of taking a couple of courses at a cooking school.
ex.zh: 她打算去烹飪學校上幾門課。

ex.en: She has to take a remedial course in English.
ex.zh: 她得去上英文補救課程。

ex.en: So you're planning to follow this course as well!
ex.zh: 所以你也打算修這門課！

course.en: a series of lessons on a subject

ex.en: "Get rid of it, of course!" answered the farmer.
ex.zh: 「當然是把它丟掉！」那位農夫回答。

ex.en: Of course you can borrow my pen.
ex.zh: 當然可以借你我的筆。

course.en: used to say yes or to show that something is clearly true

ex.en: The dinner had five courses.
ex.zh: 晚餐一共有五道菜。

ex.en: Dessert is the last course.
ex.zh: 甜點是最後一道菜。

course.en: one of the separate parts of a meal

ex.en: After looking at the research, most of us conclude that vaccines are a good thing.
ex.zh: 看完研究之後，我們大多數人斷定疫苗是好東西。

ex.en: As he has done a lot of bad things, we can conclude that he is a bad person.
ex.zh: 他做了那麼多壞事，我們可以斷定他是壞人。

ex.en: From this you can conclude that feminism is still necessary.
ex.zh: 從這點可以得出結論：女權主義仍然是必要的。

conclude.en: to decide that something is true after thinking about the facts

ex.en: The story concluded abruptly.
ex.zh: 這個故事突然結束了。

ex.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
ex.zh: 1978 年，日本和中國簽訂了和平條約。

conclude.en: to end something, or to officially complete an agreement

ex.en: Correlation does not imply causation.
ex.zh: 相關不代表因果。

ex.en: There is a strong correlation between sleep and health.
ex.zh: 睡眠和健康之間有很強的相關性。

correlation.en: a connection between two things that change together

ex.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
ex.zh: 電腦幫我們省了很多時間和麻煩。

ex.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.
ex.zh: 那就是他用來寫文章的電腦。

ex.en: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
ex.zh: 我常用 SSH 遠端連線到我的電腦。

computer.en: an electronic machine that stores information and does tasks for you

ex.en: This app is compatible with both iPhone and Android.
ex.zh: 這個 App 同時相容 iPhone 和 Android。

ex.en: Is this charger compatible with my laptop?
ex.zh: 這個充電器可以用在我的筆電上嗎？

compatible.en: able to work together with another machine or program

ex.en: They're nice people, but we're just not compatible.
ex.zh: 他們人很好，但我們就是合不來。

ex.en: The two roommates are very compatible.
ex.zh: 這兩個室友很合得來。

compatible.en: able to get along well with another person

ex.en: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.
ex.zh: 我需要幫這台伺服器設定適當的防火牆。

ex.en: You can configure the app to send you reminders.
ex.zh: 你可以設定這個 App 傳提醒給你。

configure.en: to set up a computer or program so that it works in a certain way

ex.en: Adding comments makes the code easier to read.
ex.zh: 加上註解能讓程式碼更好讀。

ex.en: She writes code for a game company.
ex.zh: 她在一家遊戲公司寫程式。

ex.en: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
ex.zh: 法蘭克用暗號留下了一則訊息。

ex.en: Enter the code to open the door.
ex.zh: 輸入密碼開門。

code.en: a secret way of writing messages

ex.en: The country code for Italy is +39.
ex.zh: 義大利的國碼是 +39。

ex.en: The office has a strict dress code.
ex.zh: 公司有嚴格的服裝規定。

code.en: a set of numbers or letters that stands for something, or a set of rules

ex.en: I couldn't prevent Tom from eating all the cookies.
ex.zh: 我攔不住湯姆把餅乾全吃光。

ex.en: All of the cookies are in the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 所有餅乾都是星星的形狀。

cookie.en: a small flat sweet cake that is baked until it is crisp

ex.en: This website uses cookies to remember your settings.
ex.zh: 這個網站使用 Cookie 記住你的設定。

ex.en: You can clear your cookies in the browser settings.
ex.zh: 你可以在瀏覽器設定中清除 Cookie。

cookie.en: a small file that a website saves on your computer to remember you

ex.en: When we looked down, we saw a concrete jungle.
ex.zh: 我們往下看，看到一片水泥叢林。

ex.en: The bridge is made of steel and concrete.
ex.zh: 這座橋是用鋼鐵和混凝土建造的。

concrete.en: a hard building material made from cement, sand and water

ex.en: He was only bothered about concrete questions.
ex.zh: 他一向只關心具體的問題。

ex.en: Can you give me a concrete example?
ex.zh: 可以給我一個具體的例子嗎？

concrete.en: real and clear, not just an idea

ex.en: The plane's wings are made of carbon composites.
ex.zh: 這架飛機的機翼是碳纖維複合材料製成的。

ex.en: The image is a composite of several photos.
ex.zh: 這張圖是好幾張照片合成的。

composite.en: a thing made from several different parts or materials

ex.en: The police released a composite sketch of the suspect.
ex.zh: 警方公布了嫌犯的模擬畫像。

ex.en: Composite materials are light but strong.
ex.zh: 複合材料輕巧又堅固。

ex.en: Turn off the lights to conserve energy.
ex.zh: 關燈節約能源。

ex.en: We must conserve our forests for future generations.
ex.zh: 我們必須為後代保育森林。

conserve.en: to use carefully, or to protect from loss or damage

ex.en: During the holidays, some university students go to Africa as volunteers and help to perfect local wildlife conservation.
ex.zh: 放假時，有些大學生會去非洲當志工，協助當地的野生動物保育。

ex.en: Energy conservation can lower your electricity bill.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以降低電費。

conservation.en: the protection of nature, or the careful use of resources

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 請檢查使用者名稱和密碼是否輸入正確。

ex.en: Do you know how to correctly hold chopsticks?
ex.zh: 你知道筷子正確的拿法嗎？

ex.en: Tomiko guessed my weight correctly.
ex.zh: 富子猜對了我的體重。

correctly.en: in a way that is right and without mistakes

ex.en: It's convenient for me to see you at ten tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚十點和你見面對我來說比較方便。

ex.en: What's the most convenient way to get to Tokyo Station?
ex.zh: 去東京車站最方便的方式是什麼？

ex.en: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
ex.zh: 這個城市的交通非常方便。

convenient.en: easy to use or suitable for your needs or plans

ex.en: You're contradicting yourself.
ex.zh: 你自相矛盾了。

ex.en: The new data contradicts our earlier findings.
ex.zh: 新的數據和我們先前的發現互相矛盾。

contradict.en: to be so different from something else that both cannot be true

ex.en: I didn't want to contradict my manager in the meeting.
ex.zh: 我不想在會議上反駁我的主管。

ex.en: Nobody dared to contradict him.
ex.zh: 沒有人敢反駁他。

contradict.en: to say that what someone has said is wrong

ex.en: I want a compact car with an air conditioner.
ex.zh: 我想要一輛有冷氣的小型車。

ex.en: This compact camera fits easily in your pocket.
ex.zh: 這台輕巧的相機可以輕鬆放進口袋。

ex.en: The apartment is compact but well designed.
ex.zh: 這間公寓不大，但設計得很好。

compact.en: small and taking up little space

ex.en: The soil becomes compact after heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後土壤變得很緊實。

ex.en: Pack the boxes in a compact way to save space.
ex.zh: 把箱子緊密堆放以節省空間。

ex.en: May I have coupon tickets?
ex.zh: 可以給我優惠券嗎？

ex.en: You can use this coupon to get 20% off.
ex.zh: 你可以用這張優惠券打八折。

ex.en: The coupon expires at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 這張折價券月底到期。

coupon.en: a piece of paper that lets you pay less for something

ex.en: Tom and I aren't friends. We're just coworkers.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我不是朋友，我們只是同事。

ex.en: He's on good terms with all his coworkers.
ex.zh: 他和所有同事都相處得很好。

ex.en: I really like my coworkers.
ex.zh: 我真的很喜歡我的同事。

coworker.en: a person who works with you

ex.en: That was beyond my comprehension.
ex.zh: 那超出了我的理解範圍。

ex.en: The test checks your reading comprehension.
ex.zh: 這項測驗考你的閱讀理解能力。

ex.en: His listening comprehension has improved a lot.
ex.zh: 他的聽力理解進步很多。

ex.en: The copier on the third floor is out of order.
ex.zh: 三樓的影印機故障了。

ex.en: Can you show me how to use the copier?
ex.zh: 你可以教我怎麼用影印機嗎？

copier.en: a machine that prints the same page again from an original

ex.en: Television has the advantage of providing sports fans with greater convenience.
ex.zh: 電視的好處是讓體育迷更方便。

ex.en: Many people shop online for convenience.
ex.zh: 很多人為了方便而上網購物。

convenience.en: the quality of being easy and useful

convenience.zh: at your convenience：在您方便的時候

ex.en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
ex.zh: 你方便的時候過來喝杯茶吧。

ex.en: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 請您在方便時盡早回覆。

convenience.en: at a time that suits you

ex.en: There's a convenience store diagonally across the street.
ex.zh: 街道斜對面有一間便利商店。

ex.en: It started raining on my way to the convenience store.
ex.zh: 我去便利商店的路上開始下雨了。

convenience.en: a small shop that sells food and everyday things and is open for long hours

ex.en: Sodium bicarbonate is commonly known as baking soda.
ex.zh: 碳酸氫鈉一般稱為小蘇打。

ex.en: Women commonly live longer than men.
ex.zh: 女性通常比男性長壽。

ex.en: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.
ex.zh: 草莓樹是這個地區常見的景觀植物。

commonly.en: in many cases or by many people

ex.en: Do you commute to school by bus?
ex.zh: 你搭公車上下學嗎？

ex.en: I spend a lot of time commuting.
ex.zh: 我花很多時間在通勤上。

ex.en: She commutes to Taipei by high-speed rail.
ex.zh: 她搭高鐵通勤到台北。

commute.en: to travel regularly between home and work or school

ex.en: My daily commute takes about an hour.
ex.zh: 我每天通勤大約要一個小時。

ex.en: I listen to podcasts during my commute.
ex.zh: 我通勤時會聽 Podcast。

commute.en: the regular trip between home and work or school

ex.en: This building is near completion.
ex.zh: 這座建築物快完工了。

ex.en: The project is scheduled for completion next spring.
ex.zh: 這個專案預計明年春天完成。

ex.en: You'll receive a certificate upon completion of the course.
ex.zh: 完成課程後你會拿到一張證書。

ex.en: The conductor raised his baton.
ex.zh: 指揮舉起了指揮棒。

ex.en: She is the conductor of the city orchestra.
ex.zh: 她是市立管弦樂團的指揮。

conductor.en: a person who leads a group of musicians

ex.en: The conductor checked our tickets on the train.
ex.zh: 列車長在火車上查了我們的票。

ex.en: Ask the conductor which stop to get off at.
ex.zh: 問問車掌要在哪一站下車。

conductor.en: a person who checks tickets on a train or bus

ex.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.
ex.zh: 在得到確認之前，不要做任何修改。

ex.en: You will receive a confirmation email shortly.
ex.zh: 你很快就會收到確認信。

ex.en: Please keep your booking confirmation number.
ex.zh: 請保留你的訂位確認號碼。

confirmation.en: a statement or proof that something is true or certain

ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
ex.zh: 聽說你通過入學考試了，恭喜！

ex.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
ex.zh: 對於您今天的成功，謹致上最誠摯的祝賀。

ex.en: Congratulations! You are our thousandth visitor!
ex.zh: 恭喜！您是我們第一千位訪客！

congratulation.en: words you say to show you are happy about someone's success

ex.en: The air conditioner has got out of order.
ex.zh: 冷氣壞了。

ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
ex.zh: 實驗室的冷氣壞了。

ex.en: Don't you think the air conditioner is turned up too high in here?
ex.zh: 你不覺得這房裡的冷氣太強了嗎？

conditioner.en: a machine that keeps the air in a room cool

ex.en: I use conditioner after washing my hair.
ex.zh: 我洗完頭會用潤髮乳。

ex.en: The hotel provides shampoo and conditioner.
ex.zh: 飯店有提供洗髮精和潤髮乳。

conditioner.en: a liquid you put on your hair after washing it to make it soft

ex.en: The first consultation is free.
ex.zh: 第一次諮詢免費。

ex.en: Book a consultation with our financial advisor.
ex.zh: 預約和我們的理財顧問諮詢。

consultation.en: a meeting with an expert to get advice or treatment

ex.en: The decision was made after consultation with the staff.
ex.zh: 這個決定是和員工商議後做出的。

ex.en: We will act in consultation with our partners.
ex.zh: 我們會和合作夥伴商量後再行動。

consultation.en: a discussion before a decision is made

ex.en: Amy is the project coordinator for our team.
ex.zh: Amy 是我們團隊的專案協調人。

ex.en: Please contact the event coordinator for details.
ex.zh: 詳情請聯絡活動統籌人員。

coordinator.en: a person whose job is to organize people and activities so they work well together

ex.en: Why did you get such a costly dictionary?
ex.zh: 你為什麼買了這麼貴的字典？

ex.en: Repairing the old machine would be too costly.
ex.zh: 修理那台舊機器太花錢了。

costly.en: having a high price; needing a lot of money

ex.en: That was a costly mistake.
ex.zh: 那是個代價很高的錯誤。

ex.en: Delays can be very costly for small businesses.
ex.zh: 延誤對小公司來說可能損失慘重。

costly.en: causing a great loss or serious trouble

ex.en: He congratulated me on my success.
ex.zh: 他恭喜我成功。

ex.en: I congratulate you on your engagement.
ex.zh: 恭喜你訂婚了。

ex.en: I should congratulate you.
ex.zh: 我要恭喜你。

congratulate.en: to tell someone you are happy about their success or good luck

ex.en: Prices have risen considerably this year.
ex.zh: 今年物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: The new system is considerably faster.
ex.zh: 新系統快很多。

ex.en: Sales improved considerably after the campaign.
ex.zh: 活動之後銷售量明顯提升。

considerably.en: by a large amount; to a great degree

ex.en: The house was full of colorful art objects.
ex.zh: 房子裡擺滿了色彩繽紛的藝術品。

ex.en: This ink is colorful.
ex.zh: 這種墨水顏色很鮮豔。

ex.en: The kids painted colorful pictures.
ex.zh: 孩子們畫了色彩繽紛的圖畫。

colorful.zh: 多采多姿的、精彩有趣的

ex.en: He has had a colorful career.
ex.zh: 他的職業生涯多采多姿。

ex.en: Grandpa told colorful stories about his travels.
ex.zh: 爺爺講了很多旅行時的精彩故事。

colorful.en: full of interesting and exciting events or details

ex.en: Sami was the only one who could fit into the costume.
ex.zh: 薩米是唯一穿得下那套戲服的人。

ex.en: The actors wore beautiful costumes.
ex.zh: 演員們穿著漂亮的戲服。

ex.en: What costume are you wearing to the party?
ex.zh: 你要穿什麼服裝去參加派對？

costume.en: clothes worn by an actor or by someone dressing up as another person or thing

ex.en: Do you give your consent to the operation?
ex.zh: 你同意進行手術嗎？

ex.en: Silence gives consent.
ex.zh: 沉默就代表同意。

ex.en: We need written consent from your parents.
ex.zh: 我們需要你父母的書面同意。

consent.en: permission or agreement to let something happen

ex.en: He consented to help the old lady.
ex.zh: 他答應幫那位老太太的忙。

ex.en: We will only consent on that condition.
ex.zh: 我們只有在那個條件下才會同意。

consent.en: to agree to something or give permission for it

ex.en: She has consistently performed well.
ex.zh: 她的表現一直都很好。

ex.en: Our team consistently meets its deadlines.
ex.zh: 我們團隊總是能如期完成。

ex.en: The rules should be applied consistently.
ex.zh: 規則應該一致地執行。

consistently.en: in a way that stays the same every time

ex.en: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
ex.zh: 編字典需要花非常多時間。

ex.en: I'm compiling a list of customers for the event.
ex.zh: 我正在整理這次活動的客戶名單。

ex.en: The report was compiled by our sales team.
ex.zh: 這份報告是由我們的業務團隊彙整的。

compile.en: to collect information from different places and put it together in one book or list

ex.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
ex.zh: 我在編譯這個軟體時遇到一些問題。

ex.en: The code takes a few minutes to compile.
ex.zh: 這段程式碼要花幾分鐘編譯。

compile.en: to change a program written by people into a form that a computer can run

ex.en: Thank you for the corrections.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的指正。

ex.en: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.
ex.zh: 我們會依照您的要求，針對需要的部分做必要的修正。

ex.en: Please make the corrections and send it back.
ex.zh: 請修改後再寄回來。

correction.en: a change that fixes a mistake

ex.en: Put your bags in the overhead compartment.
ex.zh: 請把包包放在上方的置物櫃。

ex.en: The wallet has a separate compartment for coins.
ex.zh: 這個皮夾有一個放零錢的獨立夾層。

compartment.en: a separate small space inside something larger, such as a train or a bag

ex.en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
ex.zh: 限制白糖和鹽的攝取量。

ex.en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
ex.zh: 酒類的消費量每年都在增加。

ex.en: We need to reduce our energy consumption.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少能源消耗。

consumption.en: the amount of something that is eaten, drunk or used up

ex.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的位置很方便，搭大眾運輸很便利。

ex.en: Our house is conveniently located.
ex.zh: 我們家的位置交通很方便。

ex.en: You can conveniently pay your bills online.
ex.zh: 你可以方便地在網路上繳帳單。

conveniently.en: in a way that is easy to reach or use

ex.en: He conveniently forgot to pay.
ex.zh: 他「剛好」忘了付錢。

ex.en: She conveniently left out the bad news.
ex.zh: 她很湊巧地略過了壞消息。

conveniently.en: in a way that suits someone suspiciously well, often used when you do not believe it was luck

ex.en: There is nothing wrong with boys wearing cosmetics.
ex.zh: 男生化妝沒什麼不對。

ex.en: She works for a cosmetics company.
ex.zh: 她在一家化妝品公司上班。

cosmetic.en: a product put on the face or body to make it look nicer

ex.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
ex.zh: 大部分保險都不給付整形手術。

ex.en: The changes were only cosmetic.
ex.zh: 這些改變只是表面功夫。

cosmetic.en: meant only to improve how something looks, not how it works

ex.en: It's common courtesy to reply to emails.
ex.zh: 回覆電子郵件是基本禮貌。

ex.en: Please show courtesy to other passengers.
ex.zh: 請對其他乘客保持禮貌。

courtesy.en: polite and respectful behavior toward other people

courtesy.zh: （飯店等提供的）免費服務（如 courtesy shuttle）

ex.en: The hotel offers a courtesy shuttle to the airport.
ex.zh: 飯店提供往機場的免費接駁車。

ex.en: A courtesy car is available while your car is being repaired.
ex.zh: 您的車維修期間，我們提供免費代步車。

courtesy.en: a free service or item that a business gives its guests

ex.en: He is a collector of old coins.
ex.zh: 他是舊硬幣收藏家。

ex.en: Art collectors came from all over the world.
ex.zh: 藝術收藏家從世界各地前來。

collector.en: a person who gathers and keeps things of one kind as a hobby

ex.en: A bill collector called me again today.
ex.zh: 催收人員今天又打電話給我了。

ex.en: The ticket collector checked our tickets.
ex.zh: 收票員檢查了我們的票。

collector.en: a person whose job is to gather money or things from people

ex.en: We must conform to the rules.
ex.zh: 我們必須遵守規則。

ex.en: All products must conform to safety standards.
ex.zh: 所有產品都必須符合安全標準。

ex.en: The building does not conform to local regulations.
ex.zh: 這棟建築不符合當地法規。

conform.en: to follow rules or meet a standard

ex.en: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
ex.zh: 我們的期望與現實之間的矛盾，是從何而來的？

ex.en: There is a contradiction between his words and his actions.
ex.zh: 他的言行之間有矛盾。

ex.en: The two reports are in direct contradiction.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告的內容完全互相矛盾。

contradiction.en: a situation where two things cannot both be true

ex.en: On the contrary, I've never said such a thing.
ex.zh: 正好相反，我從來沒說過那種話。

ex.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
ex.zh: 瑪麗並不窮，正好相反，她相當有錢。

ex.en: "I think you like your job." "On the contrary, I hate it."
ex.zh: 「我覺得你很喜歡你的工作。」「正好相反，我很討厭它。」

contrary.en: used to say that the opposite of what was just said is true

contrary.zh: 相反的、對立的（常用 contrary to）

ex.en: His behavior is contrary to his belief.
ex.zh: 他的行為和他的信念背道而馳。

ex.en: Contrary to our expectations, sales rose last month.
ex.zh: 和我們預期的相反，上個月的銷售量上升了。

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, the exam was quite easy.
ex.zh: 和一般人想的相反，這次考試其實很簡單。

contrary.en: completely different from or opposed to something else

ex.en: Put the drinks in the cooler.
ex.zh: 把飲料放進冰桶裡。

ex.en: We brought a cooler full of ice to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們帶了一個裝滿冰塊的保冷箱去海邊。

cooler.en: a container or machine that keeps things cold

ex.en: Osaka is the center of commerce in Japan.
ex.zh: 大阪是日本的商業中心。

ex.en: English is useful in commerce.
ex.zh: 英語在商業中很有用。

ex.en: The city is a center of international commerce.
ex.zh: 這座城市是國際貿易中心。

commerce.en: the buying and selling of goods and services, especially on a large scale

ex.en: His words convey nothing at all to me.
ex.zh: 他的話對我來說完全沒有意義。

ex.en: It's hard to convey my feelings in English.
ex.zh: 要用英文表達我的感受很難。

ex.en: Please convey my thanks to your team.
ex.zh: 請代我向你的團隊致謝。

convey.en: to make ideas or feelings known to someone

ex.en: Wires are used to convey electricity.
ex.zh: 電線是用來輸送電力的。

ex.en: The pipes convey water to the city.
ex.zh: 這些管線把水輸送到市區。

convey.en: to carry or move something from one place to another

cord.zh: 電線（power cord：電源線；extension cord：延長線）

ex.en: Is the power cord plugged into a power outlet?
ex.zh: 電源線有插進插座嗎？

ex.en: This extension cord is too short.
ex.zh: 這條延長線太短了。

ex.en: I need an extension cord.
ex.zh: 我需要一條延長線。

cord.en: a thin covered wire that carries electricity to a machine

ex.en: He caught the cord.
ex.zh: 他抓住了那條繩子。

ex.en: Tie the box with a strong cord.
ex.zh: 用堅固的繩子把箱子綁好。

cord.en: a thin, strong rope used for tying things

ex.en: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.
ex.zh: 營隊輔導員應該為學生提供指導和輔導。

ex.en: The school counselor helped me choose a major.
ex.zh: 學校的輔導老師幫我選了主修。

ex.en: She works as a career counselor.
ex.zh: 她是職涯諮詢顧問。

counselor.en: a person trained to give advice and help with personal or school problems

ex.en: The project was a collaboration between two companies.
ex.zh: 這個專案是兩家公司合作完成的。

ex.en: We work in close collaboration with our partners.
ex.zh: 我們和合作夥伴密切合作。

collaboration.en: the act of working together with others to make or do something

condominium.zh: （分戶出售的）公寓大樓、公寓單位

ex.en: They bought a condominium near the beach.
ex.zh: 他們在海邊附近買了一間公寓。

ex.en: The condominium has a pool and a gym.
ex.zh: 這棟公寓大樓有游泳池和健身房。

condominium.en: a flat in a building where each flat is owned by a different person

ex.en: It snowed for ten consecutive days.
ex.zh: 連續下了十天的雪。

ex.en: Sales grew for three consecutive years.
ex.zh: 銷售額連續三年成長。

ex.en: Our team won five consecutive games.
ex.zh: 我們的隊伍連贏了五場比賽。

consecutive.en: following one after another without a break

ex.en: I bought a cordless vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 我買了一台無線吸塵器。

ex.en: Do you still have a cordless phone at home?
ex.zh: 你家還有無線電話嗎？

cordless.en: working without a wire connected to a power supply

ex.en: She put the comb in the drawer.
ex.zh: 她把梳子放進抽屜裡。

ex.en: Where is my comb?
ex.zh: 我的梳子在哪裡？

comb.en: a flat object with teeth that you pull through hair to make it tidy

ex.en: Comb your hair before you go out.
ex.zh: 出門前先梳一下頭髮。

ex.en: Tom combed his hair.
ex.zh: 湯姆梳了頭髮。

comb.en: to make hair tidy with a flat object that has teeth

comb.zh: 仔細搜查、仔細翻閱（comb through）

ex.en: Police combed the area for clues.
ex.zh: 警方在該地區仔細搜尋線索。

ex.en: I combed through the report looking for errors.
ex.zh: 我仔細翻閱報告找錯誤。

comb.en: to search a place or a pile of things very carefully

ex.en: We sit comfortably together.
ex.zh: 我們舒服地坐在一起。

ex.en: The car seats five people comfortably.
ex.zh: 這輛車可以舒適地坐五個人。

comfortably.en: in a way that feels pleasant and relaxed for the body

ex.en: They live comfortably on their retirement savings.
ex.zh: 他們靠退休存款過得很寬裕。

ex.en: Our team won the game comfortably.
ex.zh: 我們隊輕鬆贏得比賽。

comfortably.en: with enough money or room; without difficulty

ex.en: Cold temperatures cause the contraction of metal.
ex.zh: 低溫會使金屬收縮。

ex.en: She felt her first contractions early in the morning.
ex.zh: 她清晨開始感到陣痛。

contraction.en: the act of becoming smaller or tighter, or a tightening of muscles during childbirth

ex.en: The economy suffered a sharp contraction last year.
ex.zh: 去年經濟大幅萎縮。

ex.en: Experts expect a contraction in consumer spending.
ex.zh: 專家預期消費支出會萎縮。

contraction.en: a reduction in the size or amount of something, such as business activity

ex.en: "Don't" is a contraction of "do not."
ex.zh: 「Don't」是「do not」的縮寫。

ex.en: Avoid contractions in formal writing.
ex.zh: 正式文章中要避免使用縮寫。

contraction.en: a short form of a word or words, with some letters left out

ex.en: The girl reading a cookbook is Kate.
ex.zh: 在看食譜的那個女孩是凱特。

ex.en: I bought a vegetarian cookbook yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天買了一本素食食譜。

cookbook.en: a book with instructions for preparing food

ex.en: He took her words as a compliment.
ex.zh: 他把她的話當成一種讚美。

ex.en: I'll take that as a compliment.
ex.zh: 我就當作是稱讚了。

ex.en: Thank you for the compliment!
ex.zh: 謝謝你的稱讚！

compliment.en: a kind or admiring remark about someone

ex.en: My manager complimented me on my presentation.
ex.zh: 經理稱讚我的簡報做得很好。

ex.en: Everyone complimented her on her new haircut.
ex.zh: 大家都稱讚她的新髮型。

compliment.en: to say something kind about a person's work or looks

ex.en: Continental Europe has a different climate from the UK.
ex.zh: 歐洲大陸的氣候和英國不同。

ex.en: The storm is moving across the continental United States.
ex.zh: 暴風正橫越美國本土。

continental.en: of or about a large land mass, or the main part of Europe

continental.zh: continental breakfast：歐陸式早餐（麵包、咖啡等簡單早餐）

ex.en: A continental breakfast is included in the room rate.
ex.zh: 房價含歐陸式早餐。

ex.en: The hotel serves a continental breakfast from 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 飯店從早上七點開始供應歐陸式早餐。

continental.en: a light morning meal of bread, coffee and similar things, without cooked food

ex.en: I wish copyrights didn't last so long.
ex.zh: 我希望版權的保護期不要那麼長。

ex.en: Tom always violates copyright laws.
ex.zh: 湯姆老是違反著作權法。

ex.en: Who owns the copyright to this photo?
ex.zh: 這張照片的版權屬於誰？

copyright.en: the legal right to be the only one who can copy or sell a book, song or film

copyright.zh: 取得版權（常用被動 be copyrighted）

ex.en: This book is still copyrighted.
ex.zh: 這本書仍受版權保護。

ex.en: All the images on this website are copyrighted.
ex.zh: 這個網站上的所有圖片都受版權保護。

copyright.en: to protect a piece of work with the legal right to control who copies it

ex.en: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我爸媽在鄉下過著無憂無慮的生活。

ex.en: A lot of trees grow in the countryside.
ex.zh: 鄉間有很多樹。

ex.en: We drove through the beautiful countryside.
ex.zh: 我們開車穿過美麗的鄉間。

countryside.en: land outside towns and cities, with fields, farms and villages

ex.en: There's been a complication with your order.
ex.zh: 你的訂單出了一點狀況。

ex.en: Any complications could delay the project.
ex.zh: 任何意外狀況都可能延誤專案。

complication.en: a new problem that makes a situation harder to deal with

ex.en: The surgery went well with no complications.
ex.zh: 手術很順利，沒有併發症。

ex.en: Diabetes can lead to serious complications.
ex.zh: 糖尿病可能導致嚴重的併發症。

complication.en: a new medical problem that makes an illness or treatment worse

ex.en: You are so considerate.
ex.zh: 你真貼心。

ex.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
ex.zh: 你真體貼，沒有來打擾我們。

considerate.en: careful not to upset or trouble other people

ex.en: Linda is one of the contestants in the pageant.
ex.zh: 琳達是這場選美比賽的參賽者之一。

ex.en: Each contestant has three minutes to answer.
ex.zh: 每位參賽者有三分鐘可以作答。

contestant.en: a person who takes part in a game or competition

ex.en: Daily commodities increased in price.
ex.zh: 日常用品漲價了。

ex.en: Oil is one of the most traded commodities in the world.
ex.zh: 石油是全球交易量最大的大宗商品之一。

ex.en: Commodity prices rose sharply this year.
ex.zh: 今年原物料價格大幅上漲。

commodity.en: a product that is bought and sold, especially a basic material such as oil or grain

ex.en: Time is a precious commodity.
ex.zh: 時間是寶貴的資源。

ex.en: Good engineers are a rare commodity.
ex.zh: 優秀的工程師是稀有資源。

commodity.en: something useful and valuable that people want

ex.en: Several companies formed a coalition to fight climate change.
ex.zh: 幾家公司組成聯盟對抗氣候變遷。

ex.en: The two parties formed a coalition government.
ex.zh: 兩黨組成了聯合政府。

coalition.en: a group of people, parties or countries that join together for a shared aim

ex.en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
ex.zh: 這位政治人物藉由揭露政府官員的貪腐來推動改革。

ex.en: The mayor was arrested on corruption charges.
ex.zh: 市長因貪污罪嫌被捕。

corruption.en: dishonest behavior by people with power, especially taking money in return for favors

ex.en: File corruption can happen if the computer shuts down suddenly.
ex.zh: 電腦突然關機可能導致檔案損毀。

ex.en: The backup protects against data corruption.
ex.zh: 備份可以防止資料損毀。

corruption.en: damage to computer data that makes it unreadable or wrong

ex.en: Calculate the correlation coefficient between the two variables.
ex.zh: 計算這兩個變數之間的相關係數。

ex.en: Each coefficient in the equation must be positive.
ex.zh: 方程式中的每個係數都必須是正數。

coefficient.en: a number placed before a variable in math to multiply it, or a number that measures a quality

ex.en: The conversion of the warehouse into offices took a year.
ex.zh: 把倉庫改建成辦公室花了一年。

ex.en: Use this tool for currency conversion.
ex.zh: 用這個工具換算貨幣。

conversion.en: the act of changing something into a different form, unit or use

ex.en: The new landing page improved our conversion rate.
ex.zh: 新的登陸頁面提高了我們的轉換率。

ex.en: We track conversions from each ad campaign.
ex.zh: 我們追蹤每個廣告活動帶來的轉換。

conversion.en: the act of turning a visitor or a customer into someone who buys or signs up

ex.en: The fake king plays golf while the real king consolidates his power.
ex.zh: 假國王在打高爾夫，真正的國王卻在鞏固他的權力。

ex.en: The company consolidated its position as market leader.
ex.zh: 公司鞏固了它市場龍頭的地位。

consolidate.en: to make something stronger or more secure

ex.en: We plan to consolidate our two offices into one.
ex.zh: 我們計劃把兩間辦公室合併成一間。

ex.en: You can consolidate all your loans into one payment.
ex.zh: 你可以把所有貸款整合成一筆還款。

consolidate.en: to join several things into one

ex.en: I drive a convertible.
ex.zh: 我開一台敞篷車。

ex.en: We rented a convertible for our road trip.
ex.zh: 我們租了一台敞篷車去公路旅行。

convertible.en: a car with a roof that can be folded down or taken off

ex.en: The sofa is convertible into a bed.
ex.zh: 這張沙發可以變成床。

ex.en: Is this currency freely convertible?
ex.zh: 這種貨幣可以自由兌換嗎？

convertible.en: able to be changed into another form or use

con.zh: pros and cons：優缺點、贊成與反對的理由

ex.en: Let's weigh the pros and cons before we decide.
ex.zh: 我們做決定前先權衡一下利弊。

ex.en: What are the cons of working from home?
ex.zh: 在家工作有什麼缺點？

con.en: a reason against something; a disadvantage

ex.en: He's a con man.
ex.zh: 他是個騙子。

ex.en: The whole offer was a con.
ex.zh: 整個優惠根本是一場騙局。

con.en: a trick used to get money from someone dishonestly

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a constitutional right.
ex.zh: 言論自由是憲法保障的權利。

ex.en: The court ruled that the law was not constitutional.
ex.zh: 法院裁定該法律違憲。

constitutional.en: of or allowed by the basic laws of a country

ex.en: She works for a management consultancy in London.
ex.zh: 她在倫敦一家管理顧問公司上班。

ex.en: The firm offers IT consultancy to small businesses.
ex.zh: 這家公司為小型企業提供資訊顧問服務。

consultancy.en: a company or service that gives expert advice for payment

ex.en: Tom is a communist.
ex.zh: 湯姆是共產主義者。

ex.en: I'm a communist.
ex.zh: 我是共產主義者。

communist.en: a person who supports a system where property is shared by all

ex.en: Cuba has a communist government.
ex.zh: 古巴是共產主義政府。

ex.en: He grew up in a communist country.
ex.zh: 他在一個共產國家長大。

communist.en: of or supporting a system where the government controls property and industry for all

counterpart.zh: （職位、功能相當的）對應的人或物

ex.en: The minister met his Japanese counterpart.
ex.zh: 部長會見了日本的同級官員。

ex.en: Our sales team works closely with its US counterpart.
ex.zh: 我們的業務團隊和美國的業務團隊密切合作。

counterpart.en: a person or thing that has the same job or role in another place or group

ex.en: Collective responsibility means irresponsibility.
ex.zh: 集體負責就等於沒人負責。

ex.en: It was a collective decision by the whole team.
ex.zh: 那是全隊共同做出的決定。

ex.en: Success requires collective effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要大家共同努力。

collective.en: shared by or done by all the members of a group

ex.en: The two hotels are comparable in price.
ex.zh: 這兩家飯店價格差不多。

ex.en: We offer a salary comparable to other firms.
ex.zh: 我們提供和其他公司相當的薪資。

comparable.en: similar enough in size or quality to be fairly compared

ex.en: My major is comparative religion.
ex.zh: 我主修比較宗教學。

ex.en: The report includes a comparative analysis of three suppliers.
ex.zh: 這份報告包含三家供應商的比較分析。

ex.en: The company enjoyed comparative success last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年算是相對成功。

comparative.en: measured by comparing with something else

ex.en: Signing the famous actor was a real coup for the company.
ex.zh: 簽下那位知名演員是公司的一大成功。

ex.en: Winning the contract was a major coup.
ex.zh: 拿下這份合約是一大成就。

ex.en: The government was overthrown in a military coup.
ex.zh: 政府在一場軍事政變中被推翻。

ex.en: The coup failed after just two days.
ex.zh: 政變僅兩天就失敗了。

coup.en: a sudden, often violent, takeover of a government

ex.en: Both parties must meet their contractual obligations.
ex.zh: 雙方都必須履行合約義務。

ex.en: This is a contractual requirement.
ex.zh: 這是合約上的規定。

contractual.en: written in or required by an official agreement

ex.en: Samsung is a huge conglomerate.
ex.zh: 三星是一個龐大的企業集團。

ex.en: The media conglomerate owns several TV channels.
ex.zh: 這家媒體集團擁有好幾個電視頻道。

conglomerate.en: a large business made up of many different companies

ex.en: The consolidation of the two banks created an industry giant.
ex.zh: 兩家銀行合併後成為業界巨頭。

ex.en: Industry consolidation has reduced competition.
ex.zh: 產業整併降低了競爭。

consolidation.en: the joining of several things into one

ex.en: This year is a period of consolidation for the company.
ex.zh: 今年是公司的鞏固期。

ex.en: The consolidation of our market position is our top priority.
ex.zh: 鞏固我們的市場地位是首要任務。

consolidation.en: the process of making something stronger or more secure

ex.en: Income often correlates with education level.
ex.zh: 收入往往和教育程度有關。

ex.en: We found that sales correlate closely with the weather.
ex.zh: 我們發現銷售額和天氣密切相關。

correlate.en: to have a link in which a change in one thing goes with a change in another

ex.en: No one may be compelled to belong to an association.
ex.zh: 不得強迫任何人加入任何團體。

ex.en: He felt compelled to report the incident.
ex.zh: 他覺得有必要通報這起事件。

ex.en: We were compelled to stay at home on account of the storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們不得不待在家裡。

compel.en: to force someone to do something

ex.en: The corrupt official was sent to prison.
ex.zh: 那名貪官被送進監獄。

ex.en: Corrupt officials took bribes from the company.
ex.zh: 貪官收受了該公司的賄賂。

corrupt.en: dishonest, especially by taking money for wrong actions

ex.en: The file is corrupt.
ex.zh: 這個檔案已經損毀了。

ex.en: The data on the disk was corrupt.
ex.zh: 磁碟上的資料損毀了。

corrupt.en: damaged so that a computer cannot read it correctly

ex.en: A virus corrupted the hard drive.
ex.zh: 病毒破壞了硬碟。

ex.en: Power can corrupt even good people.
ex.zh: 權力連好人都能腐化。

corrupt.en: to damage data, or to make someone behave in a dishonest or immoral way

ex.en: The commander gave the order to retreat.
ex.zh: 指揮官下令撤退。

ex.en: He is the commander of the ship.
ex.zh: 他是這艘船的艦長。

commander.en: a person who is in charge of soldiers or a military operation

ex.en: The computation took the computer several hours.
ex.zh: 這項運算花了電腦好幾個小時。

ex.en: Please check my computation again.
ex.zh: 請再幫我檢查一次計算。

computation.en: the act of working out an answer with numbers, or the answer itself

ex.en: It wasn't me, commissioner!
ex.zh: 局長，不是我！

ex.en: The commissioner announced new rules for the industry.
ex.zh: 委員宣布了這個產業的新規定。

ex.en: She was appointed as the new health commissioner.
ex.zh: 她被任命為新的衛生局長。

commissioner.en: an official in charge of a government department or a police force

ex.en: Our budget constrains what we can do this year.
ex.zh: 預算限制了我們今年能做的事。

ex.en: We were constrained by time.
ex.zh: 我們受到時間的限制。

ex.en: I felt constrained to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 我覺得自己不得不接受這個提議。

constrain.en: to limit what someone can do, or to force them to act in a certain way

ex.en: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
ex.zh: 日本正面臨嚴重的經濟問題。

ex.en: He is confronted by many difficulties.
ex.zh: 他面臨許多困難。

ex.en: We need to confront the problem directly.
ex.zh: 我們必須直接面對這個問題。

confront.en: to have to deal with a difficult problem or situation

ex.en: I didn't confront them.
ex.zh: 我沒有當面質問他們。

ex.en: She confronted her boss about the unfair schedule.
ex.zh: 她當面跟老闆反映班表不公平的問題。

confront.en: to face someone and speak to them about something they did wrong

ex.en: The job offer is conditional on a background check.
ex.zh: 這份工作的錄取要視背景調查結果而定。

ex.en: We received conditional approval from the bank.
ex.zh: 我們得到銀行的有條件核准。

conditional.en: depending on something else happening first

ex.en: There are four main types of conditional clauses.
ex.zh: 條件子句主要有四種類型。

ex.en: Can you give me an example of a conditional sentence?
ex.zh: 你可以舉一個條件句的例子嗎？

conditional.en: in grammar, describing a clause that begins with if or says what depends on something

ex.en: Betty has a previous conviction for theft.
ex.zh: 貝蒂有竊盜前科。

ex.en: The evidence led to his conviction.
ex.zh: 這些證據使他被定罪。

conviction.en: an official decision in court that a person is guilty of a crime

ex.en: She spoke with great conviction.
ex.zh: 她說話時充滿信心。

ex.en: It is my conviction that hard work pays off.
ex.zh: 我堅信努力會有回報。

ex.en: It rained continuously for three days.
ex.zh: 連續下了三天雨。

ex.en: The machine has been running continuously for 24 hours.
ex.zh: 這台機器已經連續運轉 24 小時了。

ex.en: We continuously improve our products based on customer feedback.
ex.zh: 我們根據顧客意見持續改善產品。

covenant.zh: 契約、盟約；（貸款）約定條款

ex.en: The loan agreement includes several financial covenants.
ex.zh: 這份貸款合約包含幾項財務約定條款。

ex.en: Both sides signed a covenant to protect the land.
ex.zh: 雙方簽訂了保護這片土地的協議。

covenant.en: a formal written promise or agreement, or a condition in a loan contract

ex.en: He was convicted of fraud.
ex.zh: 他被判詐欺罪成立。

ex.en: The jury convicted her of theft.
ex.zh: 陪審團判她竊盜罪成立。

convict.en: to decide in a court that someone is guilty of a crime

ex.en: The convict escaped from prison last night.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯昨晚越獄了。

ex.en: He is a former convict who started a successful business.
ex.zh: 他曾經坐過牢，後來創業成功。

convict.en: a person who is in prison for a crime

ex.en: It is important to condemn racism, but that alone is not enough.
ex.zh: 譴責種族歧視很重要，但光這樣做是不夠的。

ex.en: Many people condemned the decision.
ex.zh: 很多人譴責這個決定。

ex.en: The mayor condemned the damage to the park.
ex.zh: 市長譴責公園遭到破壞。

condemn.en: to say very strongly that something is wrong or bad

ex.en: The new policy caused a lot of controversy.
ex.zh: 新政策引起很大的爭議。

ex.en: The ad campaign sparked controversy online.
ex.zh: 這波廣告活動在網路上引發爭議。

ex.en: There is some controversy over the price increase.
ex.zh: 這次漲價引起了一些爭議。

controversy.en: a long public argument about something that people strongly disagree on

ex.en: The city is taking steps to combat air pollution.
ex.zh: 市政府正採取措施對抗空氣污染。

ex.en: New measures were introduced to combat fraud.
ex.zh: 政府推出新措施打擊詐騙。

combat.en: to try hard to stop or reduce something bad

ex.en: Tom died in combat.
ex.zh: 湯姆在戰鬥中陣亡了。

ex.en: The soldiers had no combat experience.
ex.zh: 這些士兵沒有實戰經驗。

ex.en: The game controller isn't working.
ex.zh: 遊戲手把壞了。

ex.en: The temperature controller keeps the room at 25 degrees.
ex.zh: 溫度控制器讓房間維持在 25 度。

controller.en: a device that you hold and use to operate a machine or game

ex.en: The financial controller reviews all budgets.
ex.zh: 財務主管會審核所有預算。

ex.en: She was promoted to controller last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升任財務主管。

controller.en: a person who manages a company's money and accounts

ex.en: Nobody doubts her competence as a manager.
ex.zh: 沒有人懷疑她身為主管的能力。

ex.en: The test measures your language competence.
ex.zh: 這項測驗衡量你的語言能力。

competence.en: the skill and ability to do a job well

ex.en: Please confine your comments to the topic.
ex.zh: 請把發言限定在這個主題上。

ex.en: The problem is not confined to our department.
ex.zh: 這個問題不只出現在我們部門。

confine.en: to keep something within certain limits

confine.zh: 使（因病等）不能外出；禁閉

ex.en: He is confined to bed now.
ex.zh: 他現在臥病在床。

ex.en: She was confined to her home by a bad cold.
ex.zh: 她因為重感冒只能待在家裡。

confine.en: to keep a person in a place and not let them leave

ex.en: This corn is fresh.
ex.zh: 這玉米很新鮮。

ex.en: I bought a bag of frozen corn.
ex.zh: 我買了一包冷凍玉米。

ex.en: Our breakfast has oats and corn in it.
ex.zh: 我們的早餐裡有燕麥和玉米。

corn.en: a tall plant with yellow seeds that grow on a thick stem, used as food

ex.en: The team is still in the conceptual stage of the design.
ex.zh: 團隊還在設計的構想階段。

ex.en: This is just a conceptual model, not a final product.
ex.zh: 這只是概念模型，不是最終產品。

conceptual.en: related to ideas rather than to real things

ex.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
ex.zh: 那位參議員受到國會倫理委員會的譴責。

ex.en: The bill still needs congressional approval.
ex.zh: 這項法案仍需國會通過。

congressional.en: of or relating to the lawmaking body of the United States

ex.en: He contemplated taking a trip to Paris.
ex.zh: 他考慮去巴黎旅行。

ex.en: He is contemplating whether or not to buy the book.
ex.zh: 他在考慮要不要買這本書。

ex.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
ex.zh: 他在思考現代生活的複雜性。

ex.en: She sat by the lake, contemplating the future.
ex.zh: 她坐在湖邊，思索著未來。

contemplate.en: to think about something quietly for a long time

ex.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
ex.zh: 先燙衣領的內側，再燙外側。

ex.en: Your shirt collar is dirty.
ex.zh: 你的襯衫領子髒了。

collar.en: the part of a shirt or coat that goes around the neck

ex.en: The dog is wearing a red collar.
ex.zh: 那隻狗戴著紅色項圈。

ex.en: Put the collar on the dog before the walk.
ex.zh: 出門散步前先幫狗戴上項圈。

collar.en: a band put around the neck of a pet

ex.en: A consortium of banks financed the project.
ex.zh: 一個銀行聯貸團為這個專案提供資金。

ex.en: The airport was built by an international consortium.
ex.zh: 這座機場由一個國際企業聯盟興建。

consortium.en: a group of companies or banks that work together on a big project

ex.en: We can't leave the counterparty any loopholes.
ex.zh: 我們不能讓對方有任何漏洞可鑽。

ex.en: Banks must assess counterparty risk carefully.
ex.zh: 銀行必須審慎評估交易對手風險。

counterparty.en: the other person or company in a business deal or agreement

ex.en: Consistency is key to building a strong brand.
ex.zh: 一致性是建立強大品牌的關鍵。

ex.en: The team needs more consistency in its performance.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍的表現需要更穩定。

consistency.en: the quality of always behaving or performing in the same way

ex.en: Stir the sauce until it reaches a smooth consistency.
ex.zh: 攪拌醬汁直到質地滑順。

ex.en: The paint has the consistency of cream.
ex.zh: 這種油漆的濃稠度像鮮奶油一樣。

consistency.en: how thick, smooth or firm a liquid or mixture is

ex.en: Critics contend that the plan is too expensive.
ex.zh: 批評者認為這個計畫太花錢了。

ex.en: The lawyer contended that his client was innocent.
ex.zh: 律師主張他的委託人是無辜的。

contend.en: to say that something is true, especially in an argument

ex.en: We had to contend with heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 我們得應付嚴重的塞車。

ex.en: Small shops must contend with online competition.
ex.zh: 小商店必須面對網路商店的競爭。

contend.en: to deal with a difficult problem or situation

ex.en: Three teams are contending for the title.
ex.zh: 有三支隊伍在爭奪冠軍。

ex.en: Several firms are contending for the contract.
ex.zh: 有好幾家公司在爭取這份合約。

contend.en: to try to win something against other people

ex.en: The covariance between the two variables is positive.
ex.zh: 這兩個變數之間的共變異數是正的。

ex.en: We calculated the covariance of the two stocks.
ex.zh: 我們計算了這兩支股票的共變異數。

covariance.en: a number that shows how two sets of values change together

conscious.zh: 意識到的、察覺的；刻意的

ex.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
ex.zh: 這名戰士清楚自己的優點和弱點。

ex.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
ex.zh: 更糟的是，他根本沒意識到自己吵到了鄰居。

ex.en: I made a conscious decision to work less.
ex.zh: 我刻意決定減少工作量。

conscious.en: knowing about something, or done on purpose

ex.en: The patient is still conscious.
ex.zh: 病人的意識仍然清醒。

ex.en: He was conscious when the ambulance arrived.
ex.zh: 救護車到的時候他還有意識。

conscious.en: awake and able to think and notice things

conscious.zh: （與名詞連用）注重…的、有…意識的

ex.en: Tom is environmentally conscious.
ex.zh: 湯姆很有環保意識。

ex.en: Many shoppers are price conscious these days.
ex.zh: 現在許多消費者都很在意價格。

conscious.en: caring about or paying attention to a particular thing

ex.en: We must improve our competitiveness in Asia.
ex.zh: 我們必須提升在亞洲的競爭力。

ex.en: High costs hurt the company's competitiveness.
ex.zh: 高成本削弱了公司的競爭力。

competitiveness.en: the ability of a person or company to do well against others

ex.en: Copper and silver are both metals.
ex.zh: 銅和銀都是金屬。

ex.en: This spoon is made of copper.
ex.zh: 這把湯匙是銅製的。

copper.en: a red-brown metal that carries heat and electricity well

ex.en: Communication is a core competency for managers.
ex.zh: 溝通是主管的核心能力。

ex.en: The training focuses on key job competencies.
ex.zh: 這項訓練著重於關鍵職能。

competency.en: a skill or ability needed to do a job well

ex.en: Ever since his graduation from university until his retirement, Lao Wang had continually worked as a teacher.
ex.zh: 老王從大學畢業到退休，一直都在教書。

ex.en: The software is continually updated.
ex.zh: 這套軟體會持續更新。

continually.en: again and again over a long period of time

ex.en: The event requires close coordination between departments.
ex.zh: 這場活動需要各部門密切配合。

ex.en: Better coordination could have prevented the delay.
ex.zh: 如果協調得更好，就能避免延誤。

coordination.en: the act of organizing people or things so that they work well together

ex.en: Dancing improves balance and coordination.
ex.zh: 跳舞能改善平衡感和協調性。

ex.en: Young children are still developing hand-eye coordination.
ex.zh: 幼童的手眼協調能力還在發展中。

coordination.en: the ability to move different parts of the body smoothly together

ex.en: There is a growing convergence of views between the two companies.
ex.zh: 兩家公司的看法越來越一致。

ex.en: The convergence of phones and cameras changed the market.
ex.zh: 手機和相機的整合改變了市場。

convergence.en: the process of coming together or becoming more alike

ex.en: The hospital has computerized all its patient records.
ex.zh: 這家醫院已將所有病歷電腦化。

ex.en: We need to computerize our inventory system.
ex.zh: 我們需要把庫存系統電腦化。

computerize.en: to use computers to do or store something

ex.en: The wine perfectly complements the meal.
ex.zh: 這款酒和這道菜搭配得恰到好處。

ex.en: Her skills complement mine very well.
ex.zh: 她的技能和我的正好互補。

complement.en: to go well with something and make it better

ex.en: This sauce is the perfect complement to grilled fish.
ex.zh: 這種醬汁最適合搭配烤魚。

ex.en: Online courses are a useful complement to classroom learning.
ex.zh: 線上課程是課堂學習很好的補充。

complement.en: something that goes well with another thing and makes it complete

ex.en: This blouse is cotton.
ex.zh: 這件女用襯衫是棉質的。

ex.en: These cotton socks bear washing well.
ex.zh: 這些棉襪很耐洗。

ex.en: I prefer cotton shirts in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天我比較喜歡穿棉質襯衫。

cotton.en: a soft plant material used to make cloth and thread

ex.en: The event is organized in conjunction with the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動是與市政府合辦的。

ex.en: This medicine should be used in conjunction with a healthy diet.
ex.zh: 這種藥應該搭配健康飲食一起使用。

ex.en: A conjunction joins two words or clauses.
ex.zh: 連接詞用來連接兩個字或子句。

ex.en: Can you find the conjunction in this sentence?
ex.zh: 你能找出這個句子裡的連接詞嗎？

conjunction.en: a word that joins words or parts of a sentence, such as and or but

coincide.zh: 同時發生、恰好碰在一起

ex.en: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
ex.zh: 節慶和考試剛好是同一天。

ex.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
ex.zh: 這篇文章特地安排在教授生日那天發表。

coincide.en: to happen at the same time as something else

ex.en: His opinion coincides with ours.
ex.zh: 他的意見和我們的一致。

ex.en: Our goals coincide with those of our partners.
ex.zh: 我們的目標和合作夥伴的目標一致。

coincide.en: to be the same or agree

ex.en: Tom is a sports commentator.
ex.zh: 湯姆是體育評論員。

ex.en: John Motson is one of the most famous British commentators.
ex.zh: 約翰·莫森是英國最知名的評論員之一。

commentator.en: a person who talks about news or describes a sport as it happens

ex.en: Communism is the system practiced in the Soviet Union.
ex.zh: 共產主義是蘇聯實行的制度。

ex.en: The hammer and sickle stand for communism.
ex.zh: 錘子與鐮刀代表共產主義。

communism.en: a political system in which the government owns property and industry for the people

ex.en: The congressman met with local business owners.
ex.zh: 那位國會議員和當地企業主會面。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to her congressman.
ex.zh: 她寫了一封信給她選區的眾議員。

congressman.en: a man who is a member of the lawmaking body of the United States

ex.en: The meeting will commence at 9 a.m.
ex.zh: 會議將於上午九點開始。

ex.en: Construction will commence next month.
ex.zh: 工程將於下個月動工。

commence.en: to begin, used in formal situations

ex.en: We are collectively responsible for the project.
ex.zh: 我們共同為這個專案負責。

ex.en: The employees collectively decided to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 員工們一起決定接受這個方案。

collectively.en: as a whole group, not as separate people

conspiracy.zh: 陰謀、共謀；conspiracy theory 陰謀論

ex.en: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
ex.zh: 我朋友相信陰謀論，我該試著證明他錯了嗎？

ex.en: He was charged with conspiracy to commit fraud.
ex.zh: 他被控共謀詐欺。

conspiracy.en: a secret plan by a group of people to do something bad or illegal

ex.en: Tom has been quite cooperative.
ex.zh: 湯姆一直很配合。

ex.en: I try to be cooperative.
ex.zh: 我盡量配合。

cooperative.en: willing to work with others and help them

ex.en: She buys vegetables from a local farmers' cooperative.
ex.zh: 她向當地的農會合作社買菜。

ex.en: The cooperative is owned by its members.
ex.zh: 這個合作社由社員共同擁有。

cooperative.en: a business owned and run by the people who work in it or use it

ex.en: Check the network configuration before you start.
ex.zh: 開始之前先檢查網路設定。

ex.en: The software allows custom configuration.
ex.zh: 這套軟體可以自訂設定。

configuration.en: the way the parts of a computer or system are set up

ex.en: The configuration of the seats can be changed for each event.
ex.zh: 座位的排列方式可以依活動調整。

ex.en: This room has an unusual configuration.
ex.zh: 這個房間的格局很特別。

configuration.en: the way the parts of something are arranged

ex.en: The senator listens to her constituents.
ex.zh: 那位參議員會傾聽選民的意見。

ex.en: He held a meeting with his constituents.
ex.zh: 他和選區的選民開了一場座談會。

constituent.en: a person who lives in an area and votes for its elected representative

ex.en: Water is the main constituent of the human body.
ex.zh: 水是人體的主要成分。

ex.en: The lab tested the constituents of the product.
ex.zh: 實驗室檢驗了這項產品的成分。

constituent.en: one of the parts that something is made of

ex.en: Exports are the biggest contributor to economic growth.
ex.zh: 出口是經濟成長最大的推手。

ex.en: Smoking is a major contributor to lung disease.
ex.zh: 吸菸是造成肺病的主要因素。

contributor.en: a person or thing that helps to cause a result

ex.en: She is a regular contributor to the magazine.
ex.zh: 她是這本雜誌的固定撰稿人。

ex.en: The book has more than twenty contributors.
ex.zh: 這本書有二十多位作者供稿。

contributor.en: a person who writes articles for a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: Reading helps improve cognitive skills.
ex.zh: 閱讀有助於提升認知能力。

ex.en: Lack of sleep affects cognitive performance.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會影響認知表現。

cognitive.en: related to thinking, learning and understanding

converge.zh: 匯合、聚集於一處；（意見等）趨於一致

ex.en: The two roads converge near the river.
ex.zh: 這兩條路在河邊匯合。

ex.en: Thousands of fans converged on the stadium.
ex.zh: 數千名球迷湧向體育場。

ex.en: Our views on the plan have started to converge.
ex.zh: 我們對這個計畫的看法開始趨於一致。

converge.en: to come together at one point, or to become more alike

ex.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
ex.zh: 所有會員都必須出席。

ex.en: Safety training is compulsory for all new employees.
ex.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。

compulsory.en: required by a rule or law; you must do it

ex.en: Tom couldn't conceal his disappointment.
ex.zh: 湯姆掩飾不了他的失望。

ex.en: Don't conceal what you feel about it.
ex.zh: 別隱瞞你對這件事的感受。

ex.en: We can normally conceal our thoughts from others.
ex.zh: 我們通常能對別人隱藏自己的想法。

conceal.en: to hide something so that others cannot see or find out about it

ex.en: The company took corrective action after the complaint.
ex.zh: 公司在接到客訴後採取了改正措施。

ex.en: He had corrective surgery on his eyes.
ex.zh: 他做了眼睛的矯正手術。

corrective.en: meant to fix a mistake or a problem

ex.en: The new manager will ensure continuity during the transition.
ex.zh: 新經理會確保交接期間工作不中斷。

ex.en: Every company needs a business continuity plan.
ex.zh: 每家公司都需要營運持續計畫。

ex.en: Customers value continuity in the service they receive.
ex.zh: 顧客重視服務的一致與延續。

continuity.en: the state of going on without a break or change

ex.en: I try to avoid confrontation with my coworkers.
ex.zh: 我盡量避免和同事起衝突。

ex.en: The meeting turned into an angry confrontation.
ex.zh: 會議演變成一場激烈的衝突。

confrontation.en: an angry argument or fight between people or groups

ex.en: I need to confer with my colleagues before deciding.
ex.zh: 我需要先和同事商量再做決定。

ex.en: The lawyers conferred privately for an hour.
ex.zh: 律師們私下商議了一個小時。

confer.en: to talk with others in order to make a decision

confer.zh: 授予（學位、榮譽）；帶來（好處）

ex.en: The university conferred an honorary degree on her.
ex.zh: 這所大學授予她榮譽學位。

ex.en: Membership confers certain benefits.
ex.zh: 成為會員可以享有一些權益。

confer.en: to give someone an official title, prize or advantage

ex.en: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
ex.zh: 她很樂意來，但她當時在休假。

ex.en: I know an English teacher who comes from Canada.
ex.zh: 我認識一位從加拿大來的英文老師。

ex.en: Can you come to my office?
ex.zh: 你可以來我辦公室一下嗎？

come.en: to move toward the speaker, or to have your home or origin in a place

come.zh: come up with：想出（點子、辦法）

ex.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
ex.zh: 你怎麼會想出這麼瘋狂的點子？

ex.en: We need to come up with a better plan.
ex.zh: 我們需要想出更好的計畫。

come.en: to think of an idea, plan or answer

ex.en: It won't be long before your dream comes true.
ex.zh: 你的夢想很快就會實現。

ex.en: I hope your wish comes true.
ex.zh: 希望你的願望成真。

come.en: to happen as you hoped or wished

ex.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
ex.zh: 我們必須考慮這個專案的財務面。

ex.en: I'm considering studying in the United States next year.
ex.zh: 我在考慮明年去美國讀書。

consider.en: to think carefully about something before deciding

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

ex.en: This country considers every neighboring country as a threat.
ex.zh: 這個國家把每個鄰國都視為威脅。

consider.en: to have a particular opinion about someone or something

ex.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.
ex.zh: 考慮到他缺乏經驗，他已經做得非常好了。

ex.en: Considering the weather, the event went well.
ex.zh: 就天氣而言，活動算是辦得很順利。

consider.en: used to show you are thinking about a fact when you give an opinion

ex.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
ex.zh: 一遇到甜食，我就是控制不了自己。

ex.en: The puppets are controlled by wires.
ex.zh: 這些木偶是用線操控的。

ex.en: The company controls 30% of the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司掌控了三成的市場。

control.en: to have power over something and make it do what you want

ex.en: The situation is under control.
ex.zh: 情況已經在掌控之中。

ex.en: The driver lost control of the car.
ex.zh: 駕駛失控了。

control.en: the power to direct or manage something

ex.en: How do the TV remote controls work?
ex.zh: 電視遙控器是怎麼運作的？

ex.en: The volume control is on the left.
ex.zh: 音量控制鈕在左邊。

control.en: a button or switch used to operate a machine

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一再犯同樣的錯誤。

ex.en: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
ex.zh: 醫生持續觀察病人的行為。

ex.en: She asked me to continue writing to your father.
ex.zh: 她要我繼續寫信給你父親。

continue.en: to keep doing something without stopping, or to start again after a pause

ex.en: It will be interesting to see whether this weather continues.
ex.zh: 看看這種天氣會不會持續下去，應該很有意思。

ex.en: The rain continued all night.
ex.zh: 雨下了一整夜。

ex.en: This color is a bit darker than that one.
ex.zh: 這個顏色比那個稍微深一點。

ex.en: Do you have this jacket in different colors?
ex.zh: 這件夾克有其他顏色嗎？

ex.en: We have your size, but not in that color.
ex.zh: 我們有你的尺寸，但沒有那個顏色。

color.en: something such as red, blue or green that you see in objects

ex.en: Meg colored the picture.
ex.zh: 梅格幫圖畫上了色。

ex.en: The kids colored the pictures with crayons.
ex.zh: 孩子們用蠟筆幫圖畫上色。

color.en: to add a red, blue, green or other shade to something

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
ex.zh: 咳嗽、打噴嚏或打哈欠時要摀住嘴巴。

ex.en: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.
ex.zh: 看那座被雪覆蓋的山。

ex.en: Her new hairstyle covers her ears.
ex.zh: 她的新髮型遮住了耳朵。

cover.en: to put one thing over another so that it cannot be seen

ex.en: Does the insurance cover the cost?
ex.zh: 保險有給付這筆費用嗎？

ex.en: The course covers basic grammar.
ex.zh: 這門課涵蓋基礎文法。

cover.en: to be enough to pay for something, or to include it

ex.en: Several reporters covered the event.
ex.zh: 有好幾位記者報導了這場活動。

ex.en: She covers business news for the paper.
ex.zh: 她負責替報社報導商業新聞。

cover.en: to report on an event for a newspaper or news program

ex.en: Can you cover for me tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你明天可以幫我代班嗎？

ex.en: Amy will cover for Tom while he's away.
ex.zh: Tom 不在時由 Amy 代理他的工作。

cover.en: to do someone else's job while they are away

ex.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
ex.zh: 不要以貌取人。

ex.en: Her photo is on the cover of the magazine.
ex.zh: 她的照片登上了雜誌封面。

cover.en: the outside part of a book, or a lid on a container

ex.en: Do you take part in any community activities?
ex.zh: 你有參加任何社區活動嗎？

ex.en: Tom is an activist in his community.
ex.zh: 湯姆是社區裡的活躍人士。

ex.en: The new community center opens next month.
ex.zh: 新的社區活動中心下個月開幕。

community.en: the people who live in the same area

ex.en: The online community helped me fix the bug.
ex.zh: 網路社群幫我修好了這個錯誤。

ex.en: She is well known in the business community.
ex.zh: 她在商界很有名。

community.en: a group of people with the same interests, job or background

ex.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
ex.zh: 水泥幾個小時內就會凝固。

ex.en: He's only a couple of years older than me.
ex.zh: 他只比我大一兩歲。

ex.en: Tom might be here for a couple of days.
ex.zh: 湯姆可能會在這裡待幾天。

couple.en: a small number of; about two or three

ex.en: More and more couples go on honeymoon trips abroad.
ex.zh: 越來越多新婚夫妻出國度蜜月。

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻共同分擔家務。

ex.en: In the park there are many couples who are walking.
ex.zh: 公園裡有許多散步的情侶。

couple.en: two people who are married or in a romantic relationship

ex.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
ex.zh: 學術造假比你想像的還普遍。

ex.en: Peanut allergy is the most common of food allergies.
ex.zh: 花生過敏是最常見的食物過敏。

ex.en: The surname Wang is the most common in China.
ex.zh: 在中國，王是最常見的姓。

common.en: found in many places or happening often

ex.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
ex.zh: 他們共同的目標是讓這個專案成功。

ex.en: We share a common goal.
ex.zh: 我們有共同的目標。

common.en: shared by two or more people or things

ex.en: I am sure we have a lot in common.
ex.zh: 我確定我們有很多共同點。

ex.en: The two products have little in common.
ex.zh: 這兩項產品沒什麼共同點。

common.en: to share the same interests, qualities or experiences with someone

ex.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
ex.zh: 我們的工作人員會在三個工作天內與您聯絡。

ex.en: Excuse me for not contacting you for such a long time.
ex.zh: 抱歉這麼久沒跟您聯絡。

ex.en: I contacted my parents.
ex.zh: 我跟父母聯絡了。

contact.en: to call, write to or get in touch with someone

ex.en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
ex.zh: 你還和高中同學保持聯絡嗎？

ex.en: Please leave your contact information.
ex.zh: 請留下您的聯絡資料。

contact.en: communication with someone by phone, letter or in person

ex.en: She has many contacts in the industry.
ex.zh: 她在業界人脈很廣。

ex.en: Who is your contact at the bank?
ex.zh: 你在銀行的聯絡窗口是誰？

contact.en: a person you know who may be able to help you

ex.en: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 把你的句子和黑板上的比較一下。

ex.en: After the exam we compared the answers we'd written.
ex.zh: 考試後我們對了彼此的答案。

ex.en: I want to compare plans before making a choice.
ex.zh: 做選擇之前，我想先比較各個方案。

compare.en: to look at how things are alike and how they are different

ex.en: It has greatly improved compared with what it was.
ex.zh: 跟以前比起來，已經進步很多了。

ex.en: Compared to last year, sales are up 10%.
ex.zh: 和去年相比，銷售額成長了一成。

compare.en: when you look at it next to something else

ex.en: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
ex.zh: 這個垃圾袋不含任何有害化學物質。

ex.en: The original edition is great, but the Portuguese translation contains errors.
ex.zh: 原版很好，但葡萄牙文譯本有錯誤。

ex.en: This book contains the complete works of Shakespeare.
ex.zh: 這本書收錄了莎士比亞全集。

ex.en: Firefighters worked hard to contain the fire.
ex.zh: 消防員努力控制火勢。

ex.en: The company tried to contain the damage.
ex.zh: 公司試圖控制損害。

contain.en: to keep something harmful from spreading or growing

ex.en: I am working to save for my college tuition.
ex.zh: 我在打工存大學學費。

ex.en: He studied hard in order to get into college.
ex.zh: 他努力讀書，為的是考上大學。

ex.en: What do you plan to major in at college?
ex.zh: 你上大學打算主修什麼？

college.en: a school where people study after finishing high school

ex.en: Peterhouse is the oldest of the 33 colleges of Cambridge.
ex.zh: 彼得學院是劍橋三十三個學院中最古老的。

ex.en: She teaches at a community college.
ex.zh: 她在一所社區學院教書。

college.en: one of the separate parts that make up some universities

ex.en: Winter is the coldest season of the year.
ex.zh: 冬天是一年中最冷的季節。

ex.en: The weather is getting colder day by day.
ex.zh: 天氣一天比一天冷了。

ex.en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
ex.zh: 天氣很冷，而且風很大。

ex.en: I always catch colds in the winter.
ex.zh: 我冬天總是會感冒。

ex.en: I think I'm catching a cold.
ex.zh: 我覺得我快感冒了。

cold.en: a common illness that gives you a runny nose and a sore throat

ex.en: She gave me a cold look.
ex.zh: 她冷冷地看了我一眼。

ex.en: The client was cold and unfriendly at first.
ex.zh: 那位客戶一開始很冷淡、不太友善。

cold.en: not friendly or showing no warm feelings

ex.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.
ex.zh: 今年的流行和去年完全不同。

ex.en: Tom worked all day and was completely worn out.
ex.zh: 湯姆工作了一整天，累壞了。

ex.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
ex.zh: 我爸被我的蠢問題完全嚇到了。

ex.en: An old man broke into our conversation.
ex.zh: 有位老人打斷了我們的談話。

ex.en: I didn't take part in the conversation.
ex.zh: 我沒有加入那場對話。

ex.en: There's really no way to continue this conversation any longer.
ex.zh: 這場談話真的沒辦法再進行下去了。

conversation.en: a talk between two or more people

ex.en: This is a fast and effective way of communication.
ex.zh: 這是快速又有效的溝通方式。

ex.en: Gestures are very important in human communication.
ex.zh: 在人與人的溝通中，肢體語言非常重要。

ex.en: English is a means of communication.
ex.zh: 英語是一種溝通的工具。

communication.en: the sharing of information, ideas or feelings with others

ex.en: The third generation Japanese communication methods are W-CDMA and CDMA2000.
ex.zh: 日本的第三代通訊方式有 W-CDMA 和 CDMA2000。

ex.en: Communication was cut off after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後通訊中斷了。

communication.en: the sending of messages by phone, radio or computer

ex.en: You could count to ten when you were two.
ex.zh: 你兩歲時就會數到十了。

ex.en: I'm counting how many people there are.
ex.zh: 我正在算有多少人。

ex.en: My son can count up to a hundred now.
ex.zh: 我兒子現在會數到一百了。

count.en: to say numbers in order, or to find the total number of things

ex.en: Money counts for much in political circles.
ex.zh: 在政界，金錢非常重要。

ex.en: My opinion is the one that counts!
ex.zh: 我的意見才是最重要的！

count.en: to be important or have value

ex.en: You can always count on me.
ex.zh: 你隨時都可以依靠我。

ex.en: We're counting on you to finish the report.
ex.zh: 我們就靠你完成這份報告了。

count.en: to trust someone to do something for you

ex.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡的東西都列在標籤上。

ex.en: The content of the course is very practical.
ex.zh: 這門課的內容很實用。

ex.en: We post new content on our website every week.
ex.zh: 我們每週都在網站上發布新內容。

content.en: the things that are inside something

ex.en: She says that she is content with her life.
ex.zh: 她說她對自己的生活很滿意。

ex.en: He is not content with his present salary.
ex.zh: 他對現在的薪水不滿意。

content.en: happy and satisfied with what you have

ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
ex.zh: 如果你發現錯誤，請把它改正。

ex.en: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
ex.zh: 我請老師幫我修改作文。

ex.en: Tom is correcting exam papers.
ex.zh: 湯姆在改考卷。

correct.en: to make a mistake right, or to mark mistakes in work

ex.en: Is this the correct address?
ex.zh: 這是正確的地址嗎？

ex.en: Your answer is correct.
ex.zh: 你的答案是對的。

ex.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 委員會調查了事故的原因。

ex.en: Tom was hoping the committee would adopt his proposal.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望委員會採納他的提案。

ex.en: The committee consists of scientists and engineers.
ex.zh: 委員會由科學家和工程師組成。

committee.en: a group of people chosen to make decisions or do a special job

ex.en: Things are always more complex than we think.
ex.zh: 事情總是比我們想的還要複雜。

ex.en: The situation was much more complex than he had thought.
ex.zh: 情況比他原本想的複雜得多。

ex.en: A computer is a complex machine.
ex.zh: 電腦是一種複雜的機器。

complex.en: having many parts and hard to understand

ex.en: They live in a large apartment complex.
ex.zh: 他們住在一個大型公寓社區。

ex.en: The sports complex has a pool and a gym.
ex.zh: 這個運動中心有游泳池和健身房。

complex.en: a group of buildings or a large building used for one purpose

ex.en: How can I rid myself of my inferiority complex?
ex.zh: 我要怎麼擺脫自卑情結？

ex.en: He has a complex about his height.
ex.zh: 他對自己的身高很自卑。

complex.en: a strong, often hidden, worry or feeling about yourself

ex.en: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
ex.zh: 從上下文推斷一個字的意思。

ex.en: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
ex.zh: 一個字的意思是由它所在的上下文決定的。

context.en: the words around a word or sentence that help show its meaning

ex.en: It depends on the context.
ex.zh: 這要看情境。

ex.en: If you don't understand something, it's because you aren't aware of its context.
ex.zh: 如果你不懂某件事，那是因為你不了解它的背景。

ex.en: You need to understand the historical context.
ex.zh: 你需要了解歷史背景。

context.en: the situation in which something happens that helps explain it

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下進行了一連串的實驗。

ex.en: We conduct safety inspections here on a regular basis.
ex.zh: 我們定期在這裡進行安全檢查。

ex.en: We will conduct a customer survey next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月將進行顧客調查。

conduct.en: to organize and carry out an activity

ex.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
ex.zh: 人要為自己的行為負責。

ex.en: I don't approve of his conduct.
ex.zh: 我不認同他的行為。

ex.en: The company has a strict code of conduct.
ex.zh: 公司有嚴格的行為準則。

ex.en: He has conducted the orchestra for ten years.
ex.zh: 他指揮這個管弦樂團已經十年了。

ex.en: Who is conducting tonight's concert?
ex.zh: 今晚的音樂會由誰指揮？

conduct.en: to stand in front of musicians and lead their playing

ex.en: I have a large collection of stamps.
ex.zh: 我收藏了很多郵票。

ex.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
ex.zh: 我想看看您的郵票收藏。

ex.en: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.
ex.zh: 我們學校圖書館藏書兩百五十萬冊。

collection.en: a group of similar things that someone has gathered

ex.en: The designer showed her new spring collection.
ex.zh: 設計師發表了她的春季新系列。

ex.en: This dress is from our summer collection.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝是我們夏季系列的。

collection.en: a set of new clothes or products shown or sold together

ex.en: Garbage collection is on Tuesdays and Fridays.
ex.zh: 每週二和週五收垃圾。

ex.en: We held a collection for the flood victims.
ex.zh: 我們為水災災民舉辦了募捐。

collection.en: the act of gathering money or things from people or places

ex.en: It is getting cooler and cooler.
ex.zh: 天氣越來越涼了。

ex.en: Year by year, summer becomes warmer and winter becomes cooler.
ex.zh: 夏天一年比一年熱，冬天一年比一年涼。

ex.en: Store the medicine in a cool, dry place.
ex.zh: 藥品請存放在陰涼乾燥處。

cool.en: slightly cold in a pleasant way

ex.en: Tom is the coolest person in the world.
ex.zh: 湯姆是全世界最酷的人。

ex.en: Do you think of me as a cool guy?
ex.zh: 你覺得我很酷嗎？

ex.en: That's a really cool idea!
ex.zh: 那真是個很棒的點子！

ex.en: It's easy to err once you lose your cool.
ex.zh: 一旦失去冷靜，就很容易出錯。

ex.en: My manager never loses his cool.
ex.zh: 我的經理從不發脾氣。

cool.en: to become angry or upset and stop being calm

ex.en: Let the cake cool before you cut it.
ex.zh: 等蛋糕放涼再切。

ex.en: The weather has cooled a lot this week.
ex.zh: 這週天氣涼了很多。

cool.en: to become less hot, or to make something less hot

ex.en: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
ex.zh: 和這幅比起來，那幅畫色彩鮮豔多了。

ex.en: There is a stark contrast between China's order and the chaos of the West.
ex.zh: 兩者之間形成了強烈的對比。

ex.en: In contrast, our sales grew by ten percent.
ex.zh: 相較之下，我們的銷售成長了一成。

contrast.en: a clear difference between two things

ex.en: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
ex.zh: 以下的解釋是透過比較和對照各種不同理論得出的。

ex.en: Slender and form-fitting with a high cut, the new qipao contrasted sharply with the traditional one.
ex.zh: 新式旗袍修長合身、開衩高，和傳統旗袍形成鮮明對比。

contrast.en: to show or be clearly different when compared

ex.en: She cooks chicken the way I like.
ex.zh: 她煮雞肉的方式正合我意。

ex.en: I cannot cook as well as my mother does.
ex.zh: 我的廚藝比不上我媽媽。

ex.en: I can't eat raw eggs; they must be cooked.
ex.zh: 我不能吃生蛋，一定要煮熟。

cook.en: to prepare food by heating it

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想當糕點師傅。

ex.en: Tom is an excellent cook, isn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆是很棒的廚師，對吧？

ex.en: I really like the concept of this website.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡這個網站的概念。

ex.en: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
ex.zh: 對他來說，飢餓是個抽象的概念；他從不缺吃的。

ex.en: The concept doesn’t make sense.
ex.zh: 這個概念說不通。

concept.en: an idea about how something is or should be

ex.en: He wanted to do it, whatever the consequences.
ex.zh: 不管後果如何，他都想做。

ex.en: Don't run away from consequences, don't fear them; face them.
ex.zh: 不要逃避後果，也別害怕，勇敢面對。

ex.en: You must accept the consequences of your decision.
ex.zh: 你必須承擔你的決定所帶來的後果。

consequence.en: something that happens because of an earlier action

ex.en: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
ex.zh: 因此，必須進行額外的測試，以確保完全安全。

ex.en: He missed the bus and, as a consequence, was late.
ex.zh: 他沒趕上公車，結果就遲到了。

consequence.en: used to show that something happens because of what was just said

ex.en: He contributed much to the development of the economy.
ex.zh: 他對經濟發展貢獻良多。

ex.en: Everybody's hard work contributed to the show's success.
ex.zh: 大家的努力促成了這場演出的成功。

ex.en: And everyone has the ability to contribute.
ex.zh: 每個人都有能力做出貢獻。

contribute.en: to help to make something happen or succeed

ex.en: Tom has contributed a lot of money to this hospital.
ex.zh: 湯姆捐了很多錢給這家醫院。

ex.en: Everyone contributed ten dollars to the gift.
ex.zh: 每個人出十元買禮物。

contribute.en: to give money or help to a group or cause

ex.en: She contributes articles to a travel magazine.
ex.zh: 她為一本旅遊雜誌投稿。

ex.en: Readers are welcome to contribute stories.
ex.zh: 歡迎讀者投稿故事。

contribute.en: to write something for a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
ex.zh: 我們可能會將你的個人資料和其他資訊結合。

ex.en: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.
ex.zh: 我懂很多法文單字，但很難把它們組成句子。

ex.en: I combined black-eyed beans with corn.
ex.zh: 我把黑眼豆和玉米搭配在一起。

combine.en: to join or mix two or more things together

ex.en: Their combined weight was too much and caused the truck to break down.
ex.zh: 它們的總重量太重，導致卡車拋錨。

ex.en: Their combined income is over two million dollars.
ex.zh: 他們的合計收入超過兩百萬元。

combine.en: made by adding or joining two or more things together

ex.en: Connecting a PC to the internet isn't rocket science.
ex.zh: 把電腦連上網路並不難。

ex.en: This road connects Tokyo with Osaka.
ex.zh: 這條路連接東京和大阪。

ex.en: I often use SSH to remotely connect to my computer.
ex.zh: 我常用 SSH 遠端連線到我的電腦。

connect.en: to join one thing to another

ex.en: I am not connected to this crime in any way.
ex.zh: 我和這起犯罪完全沒有關係。

ex.en: The organization is not connected with any political parties.
ex.zh: 這個組織和任何政黨都沒有關聯。

connect.en: to be related to or involved with something

ex.en: Please hold while I connect you to the sales department.
ex.zh: 請稍候，我幫您轉接業務部。

ex.en: Could you connect me with Mr. Chen, please?
ex.zh: 可以幫我轉接陳先生嗎？

connect.en: to put a caller through to another person by phone

ex.en: Thank you for all your contributions. We expect to see you again soon.
ex.zh: 感謝您的所有貢獻，期待很快再見到您。

ex.en: She made a great contribution to the team's success.
ex.zh: 她對團隊的成功貢獻良多。

contribution.en: something you give or do to help a group or a result

ex.en: We made a small contribution to the charity.
ex.zh: 我們捐了一筆小錢給慈善機構。

ex.en: All contributions will go to the local hospital.
ex.zh: 所有捐款都會捐給當地醫院。

contribution.en: money given to help a person, group or cause

ex.en: He ought to be punished if he commits a crime.
ex.zh: 如果他犯了罪，就應該受到懲罰。

ex.en: Bill did not commit the crime.
ex.zh: 比爾沒有犯下那起罪行。

commit.en: to do something wrong or illegal

ex.en: The company is committed to reducing waste.
ex.zh: 公司致力於減少浪費。

ex.en: We are committed to providing excellent service.
ex.zh: 我們致力提供優質的服務。

commit.en: to give your time and effort fully to something

ex.en: Have you committed this number to memory?
ex.zh: 這個號碼你記住了嗎？

ex.en: I committed the password to memory.
ex.zh: 我把密碼牢記在心。

commit.en: to learn something so well that you can remember it

ex.en: She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.
ex.zh: 她喜歡網球，後來成了網球教練。

ex.en: The coach considers Bob a good player.
ex.zh: 教練認為鮑伯是個好選手。

ex.en: Tom's gym teacher is Mary's basketball coach.
ex.zh: 湯姆的體育老師是瑪麗的籃球教練。

coach.en: a person who trains a sport player or team

ex.en: She coaches the school basketball team.
ex.zh: 她指導學校的籃球隊。

ex.en: My manager coached me on how to give presentations.
ex.zh: 我的主管指導我如何做簡報。

coach.en: to train a person or team in a sport or skill

ex.en: The last three coaches of the train were badly damaged.
ex.zh: 火車最後三節車廂嚴重損毀。

ex.en: We took a coach from London to Oxford.
ex.zh: 我們搭長途巴士從倫敦到牛津。

coach.en: a comfortable bus for long trips, or a separate part of a train

ex.en: I gave careful consideration to the problem.
ex.zh: 我仔細考慮過這個問題。

ex.en: That requires careful consideration.
ex.zh: 這需要慎重考慮。

consideration.en: careful thought about something before deciding

ex.en: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
ex.zh: 我們早該把時程考慮進去。

ex.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
ex.zh: 你首先要考慮的是時間。

consideration.en: to think about something when you make a decision

ex.en: Thank you for your kindness and consideration.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的好意與體貼。

ex.en: He shows no consideration for others.
ex.zh: 他一點也不體諒別人。

consideration.en: kind care for other people's feelings

ex.en: She couldn't convince him to write a song for her.
ex.zh: 她沒能說服他為她寫一首歌。

ex.en: We convinced the client to sign the contract.
ex.zh: 我們說服客戶簽了合約。

convince.en: to make someone agree to do something by giving good reasons

ex.en: I could not convince him of his mistake.
ex.zh: 我沒能讓他相信自己錯了。

ex.en: I'm not convinced that you know what you're doing.
ex.zh: 我不太相信你知道自己在做什麼。

ex.en: You seemed convinced that Tom needed to do that.
ex.zh: 你當時似乎很確定湯姆需要那樣做。

convince.en: to make someone believe that something is true

ex.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
ex.zh: 現代科技讓我們的生活更舒適。

ex.en: My room is comfortable, if it is a little small.
ex.zh: 我的房間雖然小了點，但很舒適。

ex.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.
ex.zh: 大房子住起來不一定舒服。

comfortable.en: giving a pleasant, relaxed feeling to the body

ex.en: I have never felt comfortable when I'm with him.
ex.zh: 跟他在一起，我從來沒有自在過。

ex.en: Tom never felt comfortable expressing his own opinion.
ex.zh: 湯姆從來不習慣表達自己的意見。

comfortable.en: feeling relaxed and not worried or shy

ex.en: I would like to have another cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 我想再來一杯咖啡。

ex.en: How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要怎麼喝？要濃的黑咖啡嗎？

ex.en: Two coffees with milk, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩杯加奶的咖啡。

coffee.en: a hot brown drink made from roasted beans

ex.en: You should run for city council.
ex.zh: 你應該去競選市議員。

ex.en: The city council approved the new budget.
ex.zh: 市議會通過了新預算。

ex.en: She was elected to the student council.
ex.zh: 她當選學生會成員。

council.en: a group of people chosen to make decisions for a town or organization

ex.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
ex.zh: 企業第一季的獲利大幅改善。

ex.en: She works in corporate finance.
ex.zh: 她從事企業財務工作。

ex.en: Our corporate culture values teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們的企業文化重視團隊合作。

corporate.en: of or relating to a big company

ex.en: He has great confidence in himself.
ex.zh: 他非常有自信。

ex.en: John has confidence in his ability.
ex.zh: 約翰對自己的能力很有信心。

ex.en: Where does all that confidence come from?
ex.zh: 你哪來那麼大的自信？

confidence.en: the feeling that you can do things well

confidence.zh: 信任、信心（對他人或事物）

ex.en: Investors have lost confidence in the market.
ex.zh: 投資人對市場失去了信心。

ex.en: I have full confidence in our team.
ex.zh: 我對我們的團隊充滿信心。

confidence.en: the feeling that you can trust someone or something

ex.en: I'm telling you this in confidence.
ex.zh: 我是私下告訴你這件事的。

ex.en: Please keep this information in confidence.
ex.zh: 請將這份資訊保密。

confidence.en: in a way that is meant to be kept secret

ex.en: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
ex.zh: 工作時間延長後，工人們紛紛抱怨。

ex.en: He often complains that he has a toothache.
ex.zh: 他常抱怨牙痛。

ex.en: Several customers complained about the slow service.
ex.zh: 好幾位顧客投訴服務太慢。

complain.en: to say that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something

ex.en: We have a strong commitment to quality.
ex.zh: 我們堅定致力於品質。

ex.en: He made a commitment to finish the project by May.
ex.zh: 他承諾在五月前完成這個專案。

commitment.en: a firm promise to do something or to support it

ex.en: The job requires a lot of time and commitment.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要投入大量的時間和心力。

ex.en: I admire her commitment to her students.
ex.zh: 我很欽佩她對學生的用心。

commitment.en: the willingness to give a lot of time and effort to something

ex.en: I can't come; I have other commitments that day.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法去，那天我有其他事要忙。

ex.en: Family commitments keep me busy on weekends.
ex.zh: 家庭責任讓我週末很忙。

commitment.en: something you have promised or must do

ex.en: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.
ex.zh: 這附近太吵了，我沒辦法專心。

ex.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
ex.zh: 因為噪音，我無法專心工作。

ex.en: He concentrated on his studies.
ex.zh: 他專心讀書。

concentrate.en: to give all your attention to one thing

ex.en: Most of the factories are concentrated in the north.
ex.zh: 大部分工廠集中在北部。

ex.en: We should concentrate our resources on key markets.
ex.zh: 我們應該把資源集中在主要市場。

concentrate.en: to gather in one place or around one thing

ex.en: This class consists of 15 boys and 28 girls.
ex.zh: 這個班級由十五個男生和二十八個女生組成。

ex.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
ex.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣是由氧氣和氮氣組成的。

ex.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
ex.zh: 他的薪酬包括底薪加佣金。

consist.en: to be made up of particular parts

ex.en: Here you can see beautiful colour combinations.
ex.zh: 在這裡你可以看到漂亮的配色組合。

ex.en: Cottage cheese and canned peaches are a delicious combination.
ex.zh: 茅屋起司配罐頭水蜜桃是很美味的組合。

ex.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
ex.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂和爵士樂的結合。

combination.en: a mixture of things joined together

ex.en: I forgot the combination to my locker.
ex.zh: 我忘了置物櫃的密碼。

ex.en: Only the manager knows the combination to the safe.
ex.zh: 只有經理知道保險箱的密碼。

combination.en: a set of numbers or letters used to open a lock

ex.en: This is a multi-language word comparison table.
ex.zh: 這是一張多語言的單字對照表。

ex.en: We did a price comparison before buying.
ex.zh: 我們買之前先比較了價格。

ex.en: There's no comparison between the two hotels.
ex.zh: 這兩家飯店根本沒得比。

comparison.en: the act of looking at things to see how they are alike or different

ex.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
ex.zh: 和都市生活比起來，鄉村生活平靜多了。

ex.en: In comparison with Tokyo, London is small.
ex.zh: 和東京比起來，倫敦很小。

comparison.en: when you look at it next to another thing

ex.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
ex.zh: 整體來說，日本人很保守。

ex.en: Tom is very conservative.
ex.zh: 湯姆非常保守。

ex.en: My parents are quite conservative about money.
ex.zh: 我父母在金錢上相當保守。

conservative.en: preferring traditional ideas and not liking change

ex.en: A conservative estimate puts the cost at 2 million dollars.
ex.zh: 保守估計費用約為兩百萬元。

ex.en: Our sales forecast is fairly conservative.
ex.zh: 我們的銷售預測相當保守。

conservative.en: careful and lower than what is likely to be true

ex.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
ex.zh: 湯姆覺得瑪麗不斷批評他，讓他很難應付。

ex.en: This old printer needs constant repairs.
ex.zh: 這台舊印表機經常需要維修。

constant.en: happening all the time or very often

ex.en: Keep the room at a constant temperature.
ex.zh: 讓房間保持恆溫。

ex.en: Our sales have remained constant this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年的銷售量維持穩定。

constant.en: staying the same and not changing

ex.en: Change is the only constant.
ex.zh: 唯一不變的就是改變。

ex.en: In math, pi is a constant.
ex.zh: 在數學中，圓周率是一個常數。

constant.en: something that stays the same, or a fixed number in math

ex.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
ex.zh: 已經花了相當多的時間和精力。

ex.en: The project cost a considerable amount of money.
ex.zh: 這個專案花了相當可觀的經費。

considerable.en: fairly large in size, amount or importance

ex.en: I competed with him for the championship.
ex.zh: 我和他競爭冠軍。

ex.en: Ten teams competed for the prize.
ex.zh: 十支隊伍角逐獎項。

ex.en: Small shops find it hard to compete with large chains.
ex.zh: 小商店很難跟大型連鎖店競爭。

compete.en: to try to win or to do better than others

ex.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.
ex.zh: 他命令我立刻離開房間。

ex.en: The policeman commanded them to stop.
ex.zh: 警察命令他們住手。

command.en: to tell someone firmly what they must do

ex.en: Linux experts are able to use the command line.
ex.zh: Linux 高手都會使用命令列。

ex.en: Do you know how to use these command line tools?
ex.zh: 你知道怎麼使用這些命令列工具嗎？

command.en: an instruction that you give to a computer
