ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔可以俯瞰整座城市。

ex.en: He commands the respect of a king.
ex.zh: 他像國王一樣受人尊敬。

command.en: to earn respect, or to be high enough to give a wide view of a place

ex.en: She has an excellent command of English.
ex.zh: 她的英文能力非常好。

ex.en: A good command of Japanese is required for this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要精通日文。

command.en: the ability to use a language or skill very well

ex.en: I found this column interesting.
ex.zh: 我覺得這個專欄很有趣。

ex.en: The opinion column discusses the importance of voting.
ex.zh: 這篇評論專欄討論了投票的重要性。

column.en: a regular article in a newspaper or magazine by the same writer

ex.en: Write your name in the first column.
ex.zh: 在第一欄寫上你的名字。

ex.en: Add a new column to the spreadsheet.
ex.zh: 在試算表中新增一欄。

column.en: a line of numbers or words going down a page

ex.en: The building has four tall columns at the entrance.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的入口有四根高大的柱子。

ex.en: A column of smoke rose from the factory.
ex.zh: 工廠升起一道煙柱。

column.en: a tall, round post that holds up part of a building

ex.en: How many counties are there in Florida?
ex.zh: 佛羅里達州有幾個郡？

ex.en: She lives in Hualien County.
ex.zh: 她住在花蓮縣。

county.en: a region of a country with its own local government

ex.en: I wonder when this building was constructed.
ex.zh: 我很好奇這棟建築是什麼時候建造的。

ex.en: They constructed a bridge.
ex.zh: 他們建了一座橋。

ex.en: The new station will be constructed next year.
ex.zh: 新車站將在明年興建。

construct.en: to build something such as a house or bridge

ex.en: Constructed languages are also languages.
ex.zh: 人造語言也是語言。

ex.en: Try to construct a sentence using this word.
ex.zh: 試著用這個字造一個句子。

construct.en: to put together words or ideas to make a sentence or theory

ex.en: Customer service is at the core of our business.
ex.zh: 顧客服務是我們事業的核心。

ex.en: Let's get to the core of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們直接談問題的核心吧。

core.en: the most important part of something

ex.en: Our core values are honesty and teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們的核心價值是誠信和團隊合作。

ex.en: The company will focus on its core products.
ex.zh: 公司將專注於核心產品。

ex.en: I don't eat the core of an apple.
ex.zh: 我不吃蘋果核。

ex.en: My mum helps me remove the core of the plum.
ex.zh: 媽媽幫我把李子去核。

core.en: the hard center of a fruit that holds the seeds

core.zh: to the core：徹頭徹尾、徹底

ex.en: He is rotten to the core.
ex.zh: 他壞透了。

ex.en: She is honest to the core.
ex.zh: 她是個徹頭徹尾的老實人。

ex.en: Don't complicate things any further.
ex.zh: 別再把事情弄得更複雜了。

ex.en: The bad weather complicated our travel plans.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣讓我們的旅行計畫變得更複雜。

complicate.en: to make something harder to understand or do

ex.en: In this city finding a taxi is complicated.
ex.zh: 在這個城市叫計程車很麻煩。

ex.en: This form looks kind of complicated. Help me fill it out.
ex.zh: 這張表格看起來有點複雜，幫我填一下。

ex.en: The brain is just a complicated machine.
ex.zh: 大腦只不過是一部複雜的機器。

complicate.en: hard to understand or deal with because of many parts

ex.en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?
ex.zh: 今年流行什麼款式的外套？

ex.en: She was wearing a thick coat against the chill.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件厚外套禦寒。

ex.en: I'm looking for a coat in my size.
ex.zh: 我在找我穿得下的外套。

coat.en: a piece of clothing with sleeves that you wear over other clothes outside

ex.en: The machine was coated with dust.
ex.zh: 機器上蒙了一層灰。

ex.en: Coat the chicken with flour before frying it.
ex.zh: 炸雞肉前先裹上一層麵粉。

coat.en: to cover something with a thin layer of a substance

ex.en: The wall needs another coat of paint.
ex.zh: 這面牆還需要再刷一層漆。

ex.en: Apply two coats of paint for best results.
ex.zh: 刷兩層漆效果最好。

coat.en: a thin layer of paint or another substance

ex.en: This job requires a lot of concentration.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要高度專注。

ex.en: Noise in the office affects my concentration.
ex.zh: 辦公室的噪音影響我的專注力。

concentration.en: the ability to give all your attention to one thing

ex.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
ex.zh: 新竹市區因科技產業聚集，房價大幅上漲。

ex.en: There is a high concentration of restaurants in this area.
ex.zh: 這一區的餐廳非常密集。

concentration.en: a large number of people or things in one place

collapse.zh: 倒塌；（企業、制度）瓦解、倒閉

ex.en: The house collapsed under the weight of the snow.
ex.zh: 那棟房子被積雪壓垮了。

ex.en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!
ex.zh: 要是發生大地震，房子真的可能會倒塌！

ex.en: Several banks collapsed during the crisis.
ex.zh: 危機期間有好幾家銀行倒閉。

collapse.en: to fall down suddenly, or to fail completely

ex.en: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
ex.zh: 那座舊橋有倒塌的危險。

ex.en: The collapse of the company shocked investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司的倒閉震驚了投資人。

collapse.en: a sudden fall, or the complete failure of something

ex.en: He collapsed from exhaustion after the race.
ex.zh: 他比賽結束後累到昏倒。

ex.en: A man collapsed on the MRT this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有一名男子在捷運上昏倒。

collapse.en: to fall down suddenly because you are ill or very tired

ex.en: She is unable to cope with stress.
ex.zh: 她無法承受壓力。

ex.en: The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.
ex.zh: 問題在於我們要如何應付眼前的困難。

ex.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
ex.zh: 湯姆覺得瑪麗老是批評他，讓他很難受。

cope.en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation

ex.en: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
ex.zh: 豐田公司宣布今年將裁撤一千個職位。

ex.en: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
ex.zh: 跨國企業的表現遠勝只在單一國家經營的傳統企業。

ex.en: She works for a large corporation in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她在台北一家大企業上班。

ex.en: I was very confused by his questions.
ex.zh: 他的問題讓我很困惑。

ex.en: The instructions confused everyone.
ex.zh: 那份說明讓大家都看得一頭霧水。

confuse.en: to make someone unable to think clearly or understand

ex.en: Don't confuse Austria with Australia.
ex.zh: 別把奧地利和澳洲搞混了。

ex.en: You're confusing me with someone else.
ex.zh: 你把我跟別人搞混了。

ex.en: We must never confuse the two.
ex.zh: 我們絕對不能把這兩者混為一談。

confuse.en: to think that one person or thing is another

ex.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
ex.zh: 他的日常行為和他的原則並不一致。

ex.en: Her behavior is consistent with her words.
ex.zh: 她言行一致。

consistent.en: in agreement with something else; not in conflict

ex.en: Our team has shown consistent growth this year.
ex.zh: 我們團隊今年持續穩定成長。

ex.en: You need to be consistent if you want to improve.
ex.zh: 想要進步就得持之以恆。

consistent.en: always acting or happening in the same way

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他薪水很高，生活過得很舒適。

ex.en: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
ex.zh: 你得走出你的舒適圈。

comfort.en: a pleasant state with no pain or worry

ex.en: When her friend was sad, she comforted him.
ex.zh: 朋友難過時，她安慰了他。

ex.en: Tom comforted Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆安慰了瑪麗。

comfort.en: to make someone feel less sad or worried

ex.en: Her words were a great comfort to me.
ex.zh: 她的話給了我很大的安慰。

ex.en: It's a comfort to know you're here.
ex.zh: 知道你在這裡，讓我很安心。

comfort.en: a feeling of being less sad or worried, or something that gives it

ex.en: The annual sales convention will be held in Taipei.
ex.zh: 年度業務大會將在台北舉行。

ex.en: Thousands of people attended the comic convention.
ex.zh: 數千人參加了這場漫畫展。

convention.en: a large meeting of people with the same job or interest

ex.en: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
ex.zh: 不遵守命名慣例會導致解析錯誤。

ex.en: By convention, the host speaks first.
ex.zh: 依照慣例，主辦人先發言。

convention.en: a usual way of doing something that most people accept

ex.en: Many countries have signed the convention.
ex.zh: 許多國家都已簽署了這項公約。

ex.en: The convention protects workers' rights.
ex.zh: 這項公約保障勞工權益。

ex.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
ex.zh: 細胞能把食物轉化為能量。

ex.en: Tom bought an old ambulance and converted it into a camper.
ex.zh: 湯姆買了一輛舊救護車，把它改裝成露營車。

ex.en: Can you convert this file to PDF?
ex.zh: 你可以把這個檔案轉成 PDF 嗎？

convert.en: to change something into a different form or use

ex.en: I need to convert my dollars into euros.
ex.zh: 我需要把美元換成歐元。

ex.en: How do you convert kilometers into miles?
ex.zh: 公里要怎麼換算成英里？

convert.en: to change money or a measurement into another kind

ex.en: I constantly went over this problem in my mind.
ex.zh: 我腦海裡不停地思考這個問題。

ex.en: She is constantly in and out of hospital.
ex.zh: 她經常進出醫院。

ex.en: Prices are constantly changing.
ex.zh: 價格一直在變動。

constantly.en: all the time or very often

ex.en: Tom is very confident, isn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆很有自信，對吧？

ex.en: I'm feeling really confident now.
ex.zh: 我現在覺得非常有自信。

ex.en: I'm confident that you'll succeed.
ex.zh: 我相信你會成功。

ex.en: I'm fairly confident I can do that.
ex.zh: 我相當有把握能做到。

confident.en: sure that something will happen or is true

ex.en: You'd better consult the doctor.
ex.zh: 你最好請教一下醫生。

ex.en: You should consult with a pharmacist before buying that medicine.
ex.zh: 買那種藥之前，你應該先諮詢藥師。

ex.en: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
ex.zh: 你做這個決定前，為什麼不先問我？

consult.en: to ask an expert or a person for advice

ex.en: While in England I often consulted the guidebook.
ex.zh: 在英國時，我常常查閱旅遊指南。

ex.en: Please consult the manual before using the machine.
ex.zh: 使用機器前請先查閱說明書。

consult.en: to look in a book or other source for information

ex.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
ex.zh: 塑膠已經取代了許多傳統材料。

ex.en: Electric cars are quieter than conventional cars.
ex.zh: 電動車比傳統汽車安靜。

ex.en: She chose a conventional career in banking.
ex.zh: 她選擇了在銀行工作這條傳統的職涯路。

conventional.en: following the usual or accepted way of doing things

ex.en: These things constitute a balanced meal.
ex.zh: 這些東西構成了營養均衡的一餐。

ex.en: Women constitute 60 percent of our staff.
ex.zh: 女性占我們員工的六成。

constitute.en: to be the parts that make up something

ex.en: Missing the deadline would constitute a breach of contract.
ex.zh: 錯過期限將被視為違約。

ex.en: Silence does not constitute agreement.
ex.zh: 沉默不代表同意。

constitute.en: to be considered as; to be equal to

ex.en: A committee was constituted to investigate prices.
ex.zh: 為了調查物價，成立了一個委員會。

ex.en: The new board was constituted last year.
ex.zh: 新的董事會是去年成立的。

constitute.en: to officially set up a group or organization

ex.en: We hired a consultant to improve our marketing.
ex.zh: 我們聘請了一位顧問來改善行銷。

ex.en: She works as an IT consultant.
ex.zh: 她是一名資訊顧問。

ex.en: The consultant recommended cutting costs.
ex.zh: 顧問建議削減成本。

consultant.en: an expert who is paid to give advice

ex.en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水是氫和氧的化合物。

ex.en: This compound is used in many medicines.
ex.zh: 這種化合物用於許多藥品中。

compound.en: a thing made of two or more parts mixed or joined together

ex.en: Do you know what compound words are?
ex.zh: 你知道什麼是複合詞嗎？

ex.en: The bank pays compound interest on savings.
ex.zh: 這家銀行的存款以複利計息。

compound.en: made of two or more parts

ex.en: The bad weather compounded our problems.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣讓我們的問題雪上加霜。

ex.en: His mistake was compounded by poor communication.
ex.zh: 溝通不良讓他的錯誤更加嚴重。

compound.en: to make a bad situation worse

ex.en: Your words must correspond with your actions.
ex.zh: 你的言行必須一致。

ex.en: The man corresponded to the description.
ex.zh: 這個人和描述相符。

ex.en: What he says always corresponds with what he does.
ex.zh: 他總是言行一致。

correspond.en: to match or be in agreement with something

ex.en: We corresponded by email for years.
ex.zh: 我們用電子郵件通信了好幾年。

ex.en: I still correspond with my old teacher.
ex.zh: 我還和以前的老師保持書信往來。

correspond.en: to write letters or emails to each other

ex.en: The red line corresponds to sales in Asia.
ex.zh: 紅線代表亞洲的銷售額。

ex.en: Each number corresponds to a different room.
ex.zh: 每個號碼對應一個不同的房間。

correspond.en: to be similar or equal to something

ex.en: She counsels students on career choices.
ex.zh: 她為學生提供職涯選擇的諮詢。

ex.en: The doctor counseled him to get more rest.
ex.zh: 醫生勸他多休息。

counsel.en: to give advice to someone, especially about personal problems

ex.en: The company's legal counsel reviewed the contract.
ex.zh: 公司的法律顧問審閱了這份合約。

ex.en: Please talk to your counsel before signing.
ex.zh: 簽約前請先諮詢你的律師。

counsel.en: a lawyer who gives legal advice

ex.en: He gave me some wise counsel.
ex.zh: 他給了我一些明智的建議。

ex.en: I value my mentor's counsel.
ex.zh: 我很重視我導師的建議。

counsel.en: advice that is given to someone

ex.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
ex.zh: 煤和天然氣是天然燃料。

ex.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.
ex.zh: 很多工人被困在煤礦裡。

ex.en: The prices of raw materials such as oil or coal continue to rise.
ex.zh: 石油、煤等原料的價格持續上漲。

coal.en: a hard black rock that is burned to make heat or power

ex.en: She won first prize in the speech contest.
ex.zh: 她在演講比賽中得了第一名。

ex.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
ex.zh: 我爸爸參加烹飪比賽，得了第一名。

ex.en: The contest has very strict eligibility requirements.
ex.zh: 這個比賽的參賽資格非常嚴格。

contest.en: a competition in which people try to win a prize

ex.en: He plans to contest the decision in court.
ex.zh: 他打算在法庭上對這項判決提出異議。

ex.en: The company contested the fine.
ex.zh: 公司對這筆罰款提出申訴。

contest.en: to say that a decision is wrong and try to change it

ex.en: The flight was delayed; consequently, we missed the meeting.
ex.zh: 班機延誤了，因此我們錯過了會議。

ex.en: He didn't study and consequently failed the exam.
ex.zh: 他沒有讀書，所以考試沒過。

ex.en: Sales fell, and consequently the company cut costs.
ex.zh: 銷售額下滑，公司因此削減成本。

consequently.en: as a result of what was just said

ex.en: In India, the cow is a sacred animal.
ex.zh: 在印度，牛是神聖的動物。

ex.en: Our cow doesn't give us any milk.
ex.zh: 我們的乳牛沒有產任何牛奶。

ex.en: How many cows are there in the village?
ex.zh: 村裡有幾頭母牛？

cow.en: a large farm animal that gives milk

ex.en: Due to budget constraints, we have to delay the project.
ex.zh: 由於預算限制，我們必須延後這個專案。

ex.en: Time constraints made the task even harder.
ex.zh: 時間的限制讓這項任務更加困難。

ex.en: The new law places constraints on advertising.
ex.zh: 新法對廣告加以限制。

constraint.en: something that limits what you can do

ex.en: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
ex.zh: 委員會由三男七女組成。

ex.en: The United States is composed of 50 states.
ex.zh: 美國是由五十個州組成的。

compose.en: to be made up of certain parts

ex.en: Shizuko composed a poem about the change of the seasons.
ex.zh: 志津子寫了一首關於季節變化的詩。

ex.en: He composed the music for the film.
ex.zh: 他為這部電影作曲。

ex.en: I spent an hour composing the email.
ex.zh: 我花了一小時寫這封電子郵件。

compose.en: to write a piece of music, a poem or another work

ex.en: She took a deep breath to compose herself.
ex.zh: 她深吸一口氣讓自己冷靜下來。

ex.en: He tried to remain composed during the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時他盡量保持鎮定。

compose.en: to make yourself calm after being upset

ex.en: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要多方合作才能完成。

ex.en: Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
ex.zh: 先感謝您的配合。

ex.en: He has investigated the possibility of cooperation.
ex.zh: 他研究了雙方合作的可能性。

cooperation.en: the act of working together or helping others

ex.en: I wish someone would help me with English composition.
ex.zh: 真希望有人能教我英文作文。

ex.en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
ex.zh: 你的作文寫得非常好，錯誤很少。

ex.en: I had my composition corrected by the teacher.
ex.zh: 我請老師幫我訂正作文。

composition.en: a short piece of writing done as school work

ex.en: The composition of the team has changed this year.
ex.zh: 今年團隊的組成有所改變。

ex.en: Scientists studied the composition of the soil.
ex.zh: 科學家研究了土壤的成分。

composition.en: the parts that something is made of

ex.en: This piano composition is very difficult to play.
ex.zh: 這首鋼琴作品很難彈。

ex.en: The photo has a beautiful composition.
ex.zh: 這張照片的構圖很漂亮。

composition.en: a piece of music or art that someone has made

ex.en: Do I need to put a coin in first?
ex.zh: 我需要先投一枚硬幣嗎？

ex.en: He took a coin out of his pocket.
ex.zh: 他從口袋裡拿出一枚硬幣。

ex.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
ex.zh: 他在古董店裡偶然發現這枚舊硬幣。

coin.en: a small, round piece of metal used as money

ex.en: Who coined the term "social media"?
ex.zh: 「社群媒體」這個詞是誰創造的？

ex.en: The word was coined in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 這個詞是在 1990 年代創造的。

coin.en: to invent a new word or phrase

ex.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
ex.zh: 他在思考現代生活的複雜性。

ex.en: We underestimated the complexity of the project.
ex.zh: 我們低估了這個專案的複雜度。

ex.en: The complexity of the tax system confuses many people.
ex.zh: 稅制的複雜讓很多人搞不清楚。

complexity.en: the state of having many parts that are hard to understand

ex.en: The cerebellum requires continuous blood supply.
ex.zh: 小腦需要持續不斷的血液供應。

ex.en: The machine runs in continuous operation for 24 hours.
ex.zh: 這台機器可連續運轉 24 小時。

ex.en: We are committed to continuous improvement.
ex.zh: 我們致力於持續改善。

ex.en: We have consumed all the natural resources.
ex.zh: 我們已經消耗了所有的自然資源。

ex.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
ex.zh: 農業消耗大量的水。

ex.en: This engine consumes the most oil.
ex.zh: 這具引擎最耗油。

consume.en: to use up something such as fuel, time or energy

ex.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
ex.zh: 瑞士人喝很多啤酒。

ex.en: Americans consume a lot of fast food.
ex.zh: 美國人吃很多速食。

consume.en: to eat or drink something, or to buy and use goods

ex.en: The accident caused traffic confusion.
ex.zh: 那場意外造成交通大亂。

ex.en: There was a lot of confusion at the airport after the delay.
ex.zh: 航班延誤後，機場一片混亂。

confusion.en: a situation where people are not sure what is happening and nothing is in order

ex.en: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
ex.zh: 每個函式都應該加上說明用途的註解，以免造成混淆。

ex.en: Her answer only added to my confusion.
ex.zh: 她的回答只讓我更困惑。

confusion.en: a state of not understanding, or the mistake of thinking one thing is another

ex.en: This movie is highly controversial.
ex.zh: 這部電影非常有爭議。

ex.en: This theory is very controversial.
ex.zh: 這個理論非常有爭議。

ex.en: The new policy is controversial among employees.
ex.zh: 新政策在員工之間引起爭議。

controversial.en: causing a lot of argument because people disagree about it

ex.en: We were all amused with the comedy.
ex.zh: 我們都被這齣喜劇逗樂了。

ex.en: I prefer comedies to horror movies.
ex.zh: 比起恐怖片，我比較喜歡喜劇。

ex.en: She's starring in a new romantic comedy.
ex.zh: 她主演一部新的浪漫喜劇。

comedy.en: a funny play, film or show that makes people laugh

ex.en: The United States comprises 50 states.
ex.zh: 美國由五十個州組成。

ex.en: The committee comprises ten members.
ex.zh: 這個委員會由十名成員組成。

ex.en: Women comprise 60 percent of our staff.
ex.zh: 女性占我們員工的六成。

comprise.en: to have as parts, or to be the parts of a whole

ex.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
ex.zh: 科學家可以輕易算出行星之間的距離。

ex.en: Can you compute the distance of the moon from the earth?
ex.zh: 你能算出月球和地球之間的距離嗎？

ex.en: The software computes the total cost automatically.
ex.zh: 這套軟體會自動計算總成本。

compute.en: to find an answer by using numbers

coherent.zh: 有條理的、連貫的、前後一致的

ex.en: The two sentences are both coherent.
ex.zh: 這兩個句子都通順連貫。

ex.en: She gave a clear and coherent explanation.
ex.zh: 她提出了清楚而有條理的說明。

ex.en: We need a coherent strategy for the new market.
ex.zh: 我們需要一套前後一致的新市場策略。

coherent.en: clear and logical, with all parts fitting well together

ex.en: At one time Nigeria was a British colony.
ex.zh: 奈及利亞曾經是英國的殖民地。

ex.en: Zimbabwe was once a colony of Britain.
ex.zh: 辛巴威曾是英國的殖民地。

colony.en: a country or area ruled by another country

ex.en: Ants live in large colonies.
ex.zh: 螞蟻以龐大的群落方式生活。

ex.en: A colony of seabirds nests on the cliffs.
ex.zh: 一群海鳥在懸崖上築巢。

colony.en: a group of animals or plants of one kind living together

ex.en: I'm only going to write small sentences without commas.
ex.zh: 我只打算寫一些不含逗號的短句。

ex.en: You need a comma between these two clauses.
ex.zh: 這兩個子句之間需要一個逗號。

comma.en: the mark , used in writing to separate parts of a sentence

ex.en: The newspaper published a commentary on the new policy.
ex.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於新政策的評論。

ex.en: The book includes a detailed commentary on each poem.
ex.zh: 這本書對每首詩都附有詳細的註解。

commentary.en: a written or spoken opinion or explanation about something

ex.en: We listened to the live commentary on the radio.
ex.zh: 我們聽收音機的現場實況轉播。

ex.en: The commentary during the final match was exciting.
ex.zh: 決賽時的球評解說很精彩。

commentary.en: a spoken description of a sports game as it happens

ex.en: The course focuses on improving communicative skills.
ex.zh: 這門課著重提升溝通技巧。

ex.en: The teacher uses a communicative approach in class.
ex.zh: 老師在課堂上採用溝通式教學法。

communicative.en: related to sharing information and ideas with others

ex.en: He's not very communicative in the morning.
ex.zh: 他早上不太愛說話。

ex.en: Our new manager is open and communicative.
ex.zh: 我們的新經理很開明，也樂於溝通。

communicative.en: willing to talk and share information

ex.en: Which of the composers do you like best?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪一位作曲家？

ex.en: Who is the greatest composer of all time?
ex.zh: 誰是史上最偉大的作曲家？

ex.en: Tom said that Mozart was his favorite composer.
ex.zh: 湯姆說莫札特是他最喜歡的作曲家。

ex.en: I can't conceive of living without him.
ex.zh: 我無法想像沒有他的生活。

ex.en: The idea was first conceived in 2019.
ex.zh: 這個構想最早是在 2019 年提出的。

ex.en: She conceived a plan to expand the business.
ex.zh: 她構思了一個擴展業務的計畫。

conceive.en: to form an idea in your mind; to imagine

ex.en: They tried for years to conceive a child.
ex.zh: 他們努力了好幾年想懷個孩子。

ex.en: She was unable to conceive naturally.
ex.zh: 她無法自然懷孕。

ex.en: He has no conception of how hard this job is.
ex.zh: 他完全不了解這份工作有多難。

ex.en: Our conception of success has changed over time.
ex.zh: 我們對成功的觀念隨著時間改變了。

conception.en: an idea or understanding of something

ex.en: She was involved in the project from its conception.
ex.zh: 她從專案構思階段就參與了。

ex.en: The conception of the design took two years.
ex.zh: 這個設計從構思到成形花了兩年。

conception.en: the first forming of an idea or plan

ex.en: Copper is used for its excellent heat conduction.
ex.zh: 銅因導熱性極佳而被採用。

ex.en: Water allows the conduction of electricity.
ex.zh: 水能夠導電。

conduction.en: the passing of heat or electricity through a material

ex.en: Workers placed orange cones around the hole.
ex.zh: 工人在坑洞周圍放了橘色三角錐。

ex.en: A cone has a circular base and a pointed top.
ex.zh: 圓錐體有圓形的底部和尖尖的頂端。

cone.en: a solid shape with a round base and a point at the top

ex.en: Jane wanted an ice cream cone.
ex.zh: 珍想要一支冰淇淋甜筒。

ex.en: I'd like two scoops in a cone, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩球冰淇淋，用甜筒裝。

cone.en: a thin, crisp, pointed holder for ice cream

ex.en: Tom collected some pine cones in the forest.
ex.zh: 湯姆在森林裡撿了一些松果。

ex.en: Squirrels eat the seeds inside pine cones.
ex.zh: 松鼠會吃松果裡面的種子。

cone.en: the hard, brown seed case of a pine or fir tree

ex.en: The results confounded the scientists.
ex.zh: 這個結果讓科學家們困惑不已。

ex.en: His strange behavior confounded everyone.
ex.zh: 他奇怪的行為讓大家摸不著頭緒。

ex.en: The company confounded its critics by doubling its profits.
ex.zh: 這家公司利潤翻倍，讓批評者跌破眼鏡。

ex.en: The team confounded expectations and won the title.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍出乎眾人意料地奪得冠軍。

ex.en: His actions are not congruent with his words.
ex.zh: 他的言行不一致。

ex.en: The plan is congruent with our company's values.
ex.zh: 這個計畫符合我們公司的價值觀。

congruent.en: matching or in agreement with something

ex.en: The two triangles are congruent.
ex.zh: 這兩個三角形全等。

ex.en: Prove that these two shapes are congruent.
ex.zh: 證明這兩個圖形全等。

congruent.en: having exactly the same shape and size

ex.en: The cable has a USB-C connector at each end.
ex.zh: 這條線兩端都是 USB-C 接頭。

ex.en: Check that the power connector is plugged in firmly.
ex.zh: 確認電源接頭有插緊。

connector.en: a part used to join wires, pipes or devices together

ex.en: The word cheap often has a negative connotation.
ex.zh: cheap 這個字常帶有負面含意。

ex.en: Colors can carry different cultural connotations.
ex.zh: 顏色可能帶有不同的文化意涵。

connotation.en: a feeling or idea that a word suggests beyond its main meaning

ex.en: He regained consciousness three hours after the accident.
ex.zh: 他在意外發生三個小時後恢復了意識。

ex.en: Suddenly everything went black and I lost consciousness.
ex.zh: 突然眼前一片漆黑，我就失去了意識。

ex.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
ex.zh: 他在麻醉劑的作用下失去了知覺。

consciousness.en: the state of being awake and able to know what is happening

ex.en: There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues.
ex.zh: 人們對環境議題的意識日益提高。

ex.en: The campaign raised public consciousness about mental health.
ex.zh: 這個活動提高了大眾對心理健康的意識。

ex.en: The word strength has only one vowel and many consonants.
ex.zh: strength 這個字只有一個母音，卻有很多子音。

ex.en: Some learners find this consonant hard to pronounce.
ex.zh: 有些學習者覺得這個子音很難發。

consonant.en: a speech sound made by blocking air in the mouth, not a vowel

ex.en: She traced the contour of the coastline on the map.
ex.zh: 她在地圖上描出海岸線的輪廓。

ex.en: The chair is designed to fit the contours of your back.
ex.zh: 這張椅子是依照背部曲線設計的。

contour.en: the outer line of a shape or the curved shape of an area

ex.en: Contour lines on a map show the height of the land.
ex.zh: 地圖上的等高線表示地勢高度。

ex.en: This contour map shows the hills around the lake.
ex.zh: 這張等高線圖顯示湖周圍的山丘。

contour.en: a line on a map joining places of the same height

ex.en: The witnesses gave contradictory statements.
ex.zh: 證人們的證詞互相矛盾。

ex.en: We received contradictory instructions from two managers.
ex.zh: 我們從兩位主管那裡收到互相矛盾的指示。

contradictory.en: having parts or statements that cannot both be true

ex.en: He was treated for coronary heart disease.
ex.zh: 他因冠狀動脈心臟病接受治療。

ex.en: She had coronary bypass surgery last year.
ex.zh: 她去年做了冠狀動脈繞道手術。

coronary.en: of the blood vessels that supply the heart

ex.en: We built a corpus of one million English sentences.
ex.zh: 我們建立了一個一百萬句的英文語料庫。

ex.en: The dictionary is based on a large corpus of real texts.
ex.zh: 這本字典是根據大型真實文本語料庫編成的。

corpus.en: a large collection of written or spoken language used for study

ex.en: The corpus of his poetry was published after his death.
ex.zh: 他的詩歌全集在他過世後出版。

ex.en: Scholars have studied the entire corpus of her letters.
ex.zh: 學者研究了她所有的書信。

corpus.en: all the works written by one person

ex.en: The cerebral cortex controls thinking and memory.
ex.zh: 大腦皮質掌管思考與記憶。

ex.en: Damage to the visual cortex can affect eyesight.
ex.zh: 視覺皮質受損可能會影響視力。

cortex.en: the outer layer of the brain

ex.en: Our company is a strong contender for the government contract.
ex.zh: 我們公司是爭取這份政府合約的有力競爭者。

ex.en: Three contenders remain in the bidding for the factory.
ex.zh: 這座工廠的競標還剩三個角逐者。

contender.en: a person or team trying to win something

cost-effective.zh: 符合成本效益的、划算的

ex.en: Shipping by sea is more cost-effective than air freight for heavy goods.
ex.zh: 重型貨物走海運比空運更符合成本效益。

ex.en: We need a cost-effective way to store our inventory.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個划算的方式來存放庫存。

cost-effective.en: giving good results for the money spent

ex.en: The company offers continuing education for its staff.
ex.zh: 公司為員工提供持續進修的課程。

ex.en: There are continuing concerns about rising shipping costs.
ex.zh: 外界持續擔心運費上漲。

ex.en: Ali works as a sports columnist for the newspaper.
ex.zh: 阿里是報社的體育專欄作家。

ex.en: The columnist writes about personal finance every week.
ex.zh: 那位專欄作家每週撰寫個人理財的文章。

columnist.en: a writer who has a regular article in a newspaper or magazine

ex.en: Singapore is a very cosmopolitan city.
ex.zh: 新加坡是個非常國際化的城市。

ex.en: The neighborhood has a cosmopolitan atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這個社區有多元文化的氛圍。

cosmopolitan.en: having people from many different parts of the world

cosmopolitan.zh: 見多識廣的、具國際觀的

ex.en: She has a cosmopolitan outlook from years of travel.
ex.zh: 多年的旅行讓她具有國際觀。

ex.en: Our new manager is cosmopolitan and speaks four languages.
ex.zh: 我們的新經理見多識廣，會說四種語言。

cosmopolitan.en: having wide experience of different people and cultures

cooker.zh: 炊具、鍋具（如電鍋、壓力鍋）

ex.en: Put the rice in the rice cooker.
ex.zh: 把米放進電鍋裡。

ex.en: A pressure cooker saves a lot of time.
ex.zh: 壓力鍋可以省下很多時間。

cooker.en: a kitchen machine or pot used to heat food

ex.en: The flat comes with a new gas cooker.
ex.zh: 這間公寓附有一台新的瓦斯爐。

ex.en: Turn off the cooker before you leave.
ex.zh: 出門前把爐子關掉。

cooker.en: a large kitchen machine with an oven and rings for heating food

cousin.zh: 堂兄弟姊妹、表兄弟姊妹

ex.en: My cousin, who is a lawyer, is in France at present.
ex.zh: 我的律師表哥現在在法國。

ex.en: Paul is an only child, but he has a lot of cousins.
ex.zh: 保羅是獨生子，不過他有很多表兄弟姊妹。

ex.en: Mary and Jane are cousins.
ex.zh: 瑪麗和珍是表姐妹。

cousin.en: the child of your uncle or aunt

ex.en: Tom confided in his friend that he was going to hang himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆向朋友吐露他想尋短。

ex.en: She confided in her best friend about her problems.
ex.zh: 她向最好的朋友傾訴了自己的煩惱。

confide.en: to tell someone your secrets or private feelings

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
ex.zh: 咳嗽、打噴嚏或打哈欠時要遮住嘴巴。

ex.en: He's got pneumonia. No wonder he is coughing nonstop.
ex.zh: 他得了肺炎，難怪咳個不停。

ex.en: Stop coughing. I can't hear the TV.
ex.zh: 別再咳了，我都聽不到電視了。

cough.en: to push air out of your throat with a sudden noise

ex.en: I have a cough and a little fever.
ex.zh: 我咳嗽，還有點發燒。

ex.en: This syrup is good for a dry cough.
ex.zh: 這種糖漿對乾咳很有效。

cough.en: an illness that makes you push air from your throat often, or one such sound

ex.en: Ken collects old coins.
ex.zh: 肯收集古錢幣。

ex.en: He has an interest in collecting insects.
ex.zh: 他對收集昆蟲很有興趣。

ex.en: I discovered my father collected 30 years of newspapers.
ex.zh: 我發現我爸爸收藏了 30 年的報紙。

collect.en: to gather things of one kind together

ex.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
ex.zh: 在我們的城市，大家都會仔細做垃圾分類和回收。

ex.en: I need to collect my son from school at four.
ex.zh: 我四點要去學校接兒子。

collect.en: to pick up things or people from a place

ex.en: There were a lot of people at the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會上人很多。

ex.en: Let me get you a ticket to the concert.
ex.zh: 我來幫你弄張演唱會門票吧。

ex.en: Tom hasn't missed any of Mary's concerts.
ex.zh: 湯姆從沒錯過瑪麗的任何一場演唱會。

concert.en: a public show where musicians play or sing

ex.en: The mayor gave the commencement speech to the graduates.
ex.zh: 市長向畢業生發表了畢業典禮致詞。

ex.en: Parents filled the hall for the commencement ceremony.
ex.zh: 家長們坐滿了畢業典禮的禮堂。

commencement.en: a ceremony at which students receive their degrees

ex.en: The commencement of the trial was delayed by a week.
ex.zh: 審判的開始被延後了一個星期。

ex.en: Work will begin soon after the commencement of the new term.
ex.zh: 工作將在新學期開始後不久展開。

ex.en: Coeducation became common in the twentieth century.
ex.zh: 男女合校的教育在二十世紀變得普遍。

ex.en: Many parents prefer coeducation for their children.
ex.zh: 許多家長希望孩子接受男女合校的教育。

coeducation.en: a system of teaching boys and girls together in the same school

ex.en: We can't afford to be complacent about safety.
ex.zh: 我們不能對安全問題自滿。

ex.en: After winning twice, the team became complacent.
ex.zh: 連贏兩次之後，球隊變得自滿。

complacent.en: too satisfied with yourself and not trying to get better

ex.en: He was in a combative mood and ready for an argument.
ex.zh: 他心情好鬥，準備跟人吵一架。

ex.en: The two leaders had a combative exchange on live television.
ex.zh: 兩位領導人在電視直播中進行了針鋒相對的交鋒。

ex.en: The world tolerates conceit from those who are successful, but not from anybody else.
ex.zh: 世界只能容忍有成就的人的自傲。

ex.en: His conceit made it hard for him to accept advice.
ex.zh: 他的自負讓他很難接受別人的建議。

conceit.en: too much pride in yourself and your own abilities

ex.en: Everybody knows that happiness is in contentment.
ex.zh: 誰都知道知足常樂。

ex.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
ex.zh: 無論讀書的目的是什麼，書總會帶給我們樂趣和滿足。

contentment.en: a feeling of being happy and satisfied

ex.en: He is below contempt.
ex.zh: 他讓人討厭透頂。

ex.en: He looked at the cheater with contempt.
ex.zh: 他以輕蔑的眼神看著那個作弊的人。

contempt.en: a strong feeling that someone or something has no value and deserves no respect

ex.en: Tom confessed that he had stolen the money.
ex.zh: 湯姆承認偷了錢。

ex.en: I confessed to stealing the money.
ex.zh: 我承認偷了錢。

ex.en: He confessed that he was guilty.
ex.zh: 他承認有罪。

confess.en: to admit that you have done something wrong

ex.en: I was very confused by his questions.
ex.zh: 我對他的問題感到很困惑。

ex.en: Mary said that she was confused.
ex.zh: 瑪麗說她很困惑。

ex.en: Tom seems a little confused.
ex.zh: 湯姆看來有點困惑。

confused.en: unable to think clearly or understand

ex.en: Happy is the man who is contented.
ex.zh: 知足常樂。

ex.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
ex.zh: 儘管他很富有，他還是不滿足。

contented.en: happy and satisfied with your life or situation

ex.en: The compassionate nurse stayed with the frightened child.
ex.zh: 有同情心的護理師陪著受驚的孩子。

ex.en: He is a compassionate man who gives to charity every month.
ex.zh: 他是個很有同情心的人，每個月都捐款做慈善。

compassionate.en: feeling sorry for other people's pain and wanting to help

ex.en: It was a small consolation that nobody was hurt.
ex.zh: 沒有人受傷，多少算是一點安慰。

ex.en: She found consolation in music after her loss.
ex.zh: 她在失去親人後從音樂中找到慰藉。

consolation.en: comfort given to someone who is sad or has lost something

ex.en: He is so conceited that he thinks everyone admires him.
ex.zh: 他自大到以為每個人都很欽佩他。

ex.en: Nobody likes a conceited person who only talks about himself.
ex.zh: 沒有人喜歡只談論自己的自負之人。

conceited.en: having too high an opinion of yourself

ex.en: Stealing from the poor is a contemptible act.
ex.zh: 偷窮人的東西是卑劣的行為。

ex.en: I think his lies about the accident were contemptible.
ex.zh: 我認為他關於這起事故的謊言很可鄙。

contemptible.en: so bad that it deserves no respect

ex.en: Running away was an act of cowardice.
ex.zh: 逃跑是懦弱的行為。

ex.en: He was ashamed of his cowardice during the fire.
ex.zh: 他為自己在火災中的怯懦感到羞愧。

cowardice.en: lack of courage when facing danger or difficulty

ex.en: He conceitedly announced that he was the best player on the team.
ex.zh: 他自負地宣稱自己是隊上最好的球員。

ex.en: She smiled conceitedly at the praise.
ex.zh: 她得意自負地對讚美微笑。

conceitedly.en: in a way that shows too much pride in yourself

ex.en: There was a commotion outside the office when the fire alarm went off.
ex.zh: 火災警報響起時，辦公室外一陣騷動。

ex.en: What's all the commotion about?
ex.zh: 大家在吵什麼？

commotion.en: sudden noisy activity, usually caused by excited or upset people

ex.en: Put a cooling gel pad on your forehead to bring down the fever.
ex.zh: 在額頭貼退熱貼來幫助退燒。

ex.en: A cooling breeze blew in from the sea.
ex.zh: 一陣涼爽的微風從海上吹來。

cooling.en: making something less hot or feeling pleasantly cold

ex.en: The computer needs better cooling to stop it from overheating.
ex.zh: 這台電腦需要更好的散熱，才不會過熱。

ex.en: Cooling of the burn with running water should begin immediately.
ex.zh: 燙傷應立即用流動的清水沖洗降溫。

cooling.en: the process of becoming or making something less hot

ex.en: Physical conditioning helps athletes avoid injuries.
ex.zh: 體能訓練能幫助運動員避免受傷。

ex.en: Fear of the dentist can be the result of conditioning in childhood.
ex.zh: 害怕看牙醫可能是童年時期制約的結果。

conditioning.en: training or practice that makes a person or animal fit or used to something

ex.en: Does the room have air conditioning?
ex.zh: 房間有冷氣嗎？

ex.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天沒有冷氣我會活不下去。

ex.en: The air conditioning in the laboratory is broken.
ex.zh: 實驗室的冷氣壞了。

conditioning.en: a system that keeps the air in a building cool and fresh

ex.en: Cocaine is an illegal drug that can damage the heart.
ex.zh: 古柯鹼是一種會傷害心臟的非法毒品。

ex.en: Doctors once used cocaine as a local anesthetic.
ex.zh: 醫生以前曾用古柯鹼當作局部麻醉劑。

cocaine.en: a strong illegal drug, usually a white powder

ex.en: My sister is color blind.
ex.zh: 我姊姊是色盲。

ex.en: I'm color blind.
ex.zh: 我是色盲。

ex.en: Being color blind, he finds it hard to tell red from green.
ex.zh: 他是色盲，很難分辨紅色和綠色。

color blind.en: unable to see the difference between certain colors, such as red and green

ex.en: After the accident, she received counseling to deal with her fear.
ex.zh: 車禍後，她接受了心理諮商來面對恐懼。

ex.en: The school offers free counseling to students.
ex.zh: 學校為學生提供免費的輔導。

counseling.en: professional advice and help for people with personal problems

ex.en: Condoms offer protection against sexually transmitted diseases.
ex.zh: 保險套可以預防性病。

ex.en: Condoms are an effective measure to prevent HIV and many other diseases.
ex.zh: 保險套是預防愛滋病毒和許多其他疾病的有效方法。

ex.en: The health center gives out free condoms to prevent disease.
ex.zh: 衛生所免費發放保險套以預防疾病。

condom.en: a thin rubber cover worn during sex to prevent pregnancy and disease

ex.en: She tried to console him.
ex.zh: 她試著安慰他。

ex.en: Tom is consoling Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆在安慰瑪麗。

ex.en: He's consoling his mother.
ex.zh: 他在安慰他的母親。

console.en: to make someone feel less sad

ex.en: My brother spends hours playing games on his new console.
ex.zh: 我弟弟花好幾個小時玩他的新遊戲主機。

ex.en: Open the console to check the error messages from the program.
ex.zh: 打開控制台查看程式的錯誤訊息。

console.en: a panel with controls, or a small machine used for playing video games

ex.en: Tom is running for Congress.
ex.zh: 湯姆在競選國會議員。

ex.en: The new law must be approved by Congress before it takes effect.
ex.zh: 新法律必須先經過國會通過才能生效。

ex.en: Doctors from forty countries attended the medical congress in Taipei.
ex.zh: 來自四十個國家的醫師參加了在台北舉行的醫學大會。

congress.en: a country's lawmaking group, or a large formal meeting of delegates

ex.en: He does nothing but read comics.
ex.zh: 他什麼都不做只是看漫畫。

ex.en: My hobby is reading comics.
ex.zh: 我的嗜好是看漫畫書。

ex.en: I borrowed this comic from his sister.
ex.zh: 我向他妹妹借了這本漫畫。

comic.en: a magazine with stories told in pictures, or a person who tells jokes for a job

ex.en: The actor is famous for his comic roles in family movies.
ex.zh: 這位演員以在闔家觀賞的電影中演出喜劇角色而聞名。

ex.en: Her comic timing made the whole class burst out laughing.
ex.zh: 她搞笑的時機抓得剛好，讓全班哄堂大笑。

comic.en: funny or meant to make people laugh

ex.en: The two partners have complementary skills, so they work well together.
ex.zh: 這兩位合夥人的能力互補，所以合作得很好。

ex.en: Exercise and a healthy diet are complementary parts of staying fit.
ex.zh: 運動和健康飲食是保持身材相輔相成的兩部分。

complementary.en: going well together by adding what the other lacks

ex.en: Some people prefer conformity, while others seek novelty.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡循規蹈矩，而有些人總喜歡尋求刺激。

ex.en: Some schools value conformity more than creativity.
ex.zh: 有些學校重視循規蹈矩勝過創意。

conformity.en: the act of following the usual rules or behavior of a group

ex.en: Maybe it was just a coincidence.
ex.zh: 也許這只是一場巧合。

ex.en: What a coincidence!
ex.zh: 真是個巧合！

ex.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.
ex.zh: 湯姆不認為這是一個巧合。

coincidence.en: a surprising event that happens by chance at the same time as another

ex.en: She walked confidently onto the stage and began her speech.
ex.zh: 她自信地走上舞台，開始演講。

ex.en: He answered the interviewer's questions calmly and confidently.
ex.zh: 他冷靜又自信地回答面試官的問題。

confidently.en: in a way that shows you are sure of yourself

ex.en: After her husband died, she got a cat for companionship.
ex.zh: 丈夫過世後，她養了一隻貓作伴。

ex.en: Many elderly people need companionship more than money.
ex.zh: 許多長輩需要的是陪伴，而不是金錢。

companionship.en: the pleasant feeling of having a friend with you

ex.en: She is the BBC's correspondent in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 她是 BBC 駐東京的特派員。

ex.en: Our correspondent reports from the scene.
ex.zh: 我們的特派記者在現場為您報導。

correspondent.en: a reporter who sends news from a distant place

ex.en: The election got a lot of media coverage.
ex.zh: 這次選舉受到媒體大量報導。

ex.en: Live coverage of the game starts at eight.
ex.zh: 比賽的現場轉播八點開始。

coverage.en: the reporting of news about an event in newspapers or on television

ex.en: Does your insurance include coverage for dental care?
ex.zh: 你的保險有涵蓋牙科嗎？

ex.en: There's no mobile coverage in the mountains.
ex.zh: 山區沒有手機訊號。

coverage.en: the range of things or places that insurance or a signal includes

ex.en: She represents a rural constituency.
ex.zh: 她代表一個鄉村選區。

ex.en: The politician visited his constituency every weekend.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物每個週末都回選區走訪。

constituency.en: an area that elects a representative, or the voters who live there

ex.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.
ex.zh: 被告週五將出庭。

ex.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
ex.zh: 被告會向上級法院上訴。

ex.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
ex.zh: 法院判決他謀殺罪名不成立。

court.en: a place where a judge decides legal cases

ex.en: The tennis courts are behind the school.
ex.zh: 網球場在學校後面。

ex.en: The players ran onto the court.
ex.zh: 球員們跑上球場。

court.en: an area marked out for playing a game such as tennis

ex.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
ex.zh: 思想自由受憲法保障。

ex.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
ex.zh: 平等受到憲法保障。

ex.en: The U.S. Constitution was poorly written.
ex.zh: 美國憲法寫得很糟。

constitution.en: the basic laws of a country or organization

ex.en: He has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick.
ex.zh: 他體質很好，很少生病。

ex.en: She has a delicate constitution.
ex.zh: 她體質很弱。

constitution.en: the general state of a person's body and health

ex.en: Japanese companies have built up a reputation for quality.
ex.zh: 日本企業已經建立了品質好的聲譽。

ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 那家公司在廣告上花了很多錢。

ex.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
ex.zh: 很多公司實施每天八小時工作制。

company.en: a business that sells goods or services

ex.en: I never felt at ease in my father's company.
ex.zh: 跟我爸爸在一起時，我從來沒自在過。

ex.en: I enjoy her company.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡跟她在一起。

company.en: the state of being with another person, or a person who is with you

ex.en: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
ex.zh: 可是在「真正的大人世界」裡，競爭很多。

ex.en: There is strong competition between the two companies.
ex.zh: 兩家公司之間競爭激烈。

competition.en: a situation in which people try to be better or more successful than others

ex.en: He would like to take part in the competition.
ex.zh: 他想參加比賽。

ex.en: She won many competitions.
ex.zh: 她贏過很多比賽。

ex.en: Our team is seeded in the ping-pong competition.
ex.zh: 我們隊在桌球比賽中是種子隊。

competition.en: an event in which people try to win a prize

ex.en: The Dragon Boat Festival commemorates Qu Yuan.
ex.zh: 端午節是為了紀念屈原。

ex.en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
ex.zh: 民兵雕像是為了紀念在獨立戰爭中英勇作戰的士兵。

commemorate.en: to remember an important person or event with a ceremony

ex.en: He studies contemporary literature.
ex.zh: 他研究當代文學。

ex.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
ex.zh: 他在思考當代生活的複雜。

ex.en: The level of education of contemporary people is far higher than it has been in the past.
ex.zh: 現代人的教育程度比過去高得多。

ex.en: The city has many colonial buildings.
ex.zh: 這座城市有很多殖民時期的建築。

ex.en: Taiwan was under Japanese colonial rule for fifty years.
ex.zh: 台灣曾經被日本殖民統治五十年。

colonial.en: of or from the time when a country was ruled by another country

ex.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上很多國家都說英語。

ex.en: There are many countries and many cultures on Earth.
ex.zh: 地球上有很多國家和文化。

ex.en: India is the seventh largest country in the world.
ex.zh: 印度是世界第七大的國家。

country.en: an area of land with its own government and borders

ex.en: They moved to the country to live a quieter life.
ex.zh: 他們搬到鄉下過比較寧靜的生活。

ex.en: I grew up in the country.
ex.zh: 我在鄉下長大。

country.en: land outside towns, with farms and open space

ex.en: There are seven continents on the earth.
ex.zh: 地球上有七大洲。

ex.en: Africa is a continent, but Greenland is not.
ex.zh: 非洲是一個洲，格陵蘭不是。

ex.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
ex.zh: 哥倫布往更西邊航行，尋找新大陸。

continent.en: one of the seven very large areas of land on Earth

ex.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
ex.zh: 那座小鎮離海岸兩英里。

ex.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
ex.zh: 他們沿著非洲西岸航行。

ex.en: More than a third of the world population lives near a coast.
ex.zh: 全世界超過三分之一的人口住在海岸附近。

ex.en: These containers are airtight.
ex.zh: 這些容器是密封的。

ex.en: Keep the cookies in an airtight container.
ex.zh: 把餅乾放在密封容器裡。

container.en: a box, bottle or other object used to hold things

ex.en: The port handles thousands of containers every day.
ex.zh: 這個港口每天處理數千個貨櫃。

ex.en: The goods were shipped in a 40-foot container.
ex.zh: 這批貨用 40 呎貨櫃運送。

container.en: a very large metal box used to carry goods on ships and trucks

ex.en: I'll send the documents by courier.
ex.zh: 我會用快遞寄文件。

ex.en: The courier delivered the package this morning.
ex.zh: 快遞員今天早上送來了包裹。

courier.en: a person or company that carries packages and documents quickly

ex.en: Many companies have attempted to manufacture this complex component at scale, but so far only ours has succeeded.
ex.zh: 許多公司都嘗試過大規模生產這種複雜的零件，但目前只有我們成功了。

ex.en: The factory makes components for smartphones.
ex.zh: 這家工廠生產智慧型手機的零件。

component.en: one of the parts that a machine is made of

ex.en: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
ex.zh: 宗族制度是中國傳統文化的重要組成部分。

ex.en: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
ex.zh: 漢字的基本組成單位叫做「部首」。

component.en: one of the parts that make up something

ex.en: All products must be in compliance with safety standards.
ex.zh: 所有產品都必須符合安全標準。

ex.en: She works in the compliance department of a bank.
ex.zh: 她在一家銀行的法遵部門工作。

compliance.en: the act of obeying a rule, law or request

ex.en: I attend scientific conferences.
ex.zh: 我會參加科學研討會。

ex.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 會議將在東京舉行。

ex.en: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
ex.zh: 許多國家的代表出席了這場會議。

conference.en: a large meeting where people discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
ex.zh: 歐洲人是世界上最大的酒精消費者。

ex.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
ex.zh: 一般來說，消費者比較重視數量而不是品質。

ex.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
ex.zh: 公司歡迎使用產品的消費者提供回饋意見。

consumer.en: a person who buys and uses goods and services

ex.en: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?
ex.zh: 她是強大的對手，不是嗎？

ex.en: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
ex.zh: 由於兩家競爭對手簽了新協議，我們需要重新調整策略。

competitor.en: a person or company trying to win or sell more than others

ex.en: I saw a funny commercial on TV last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚在電視上看到一支很好笑的廣告。

ex.en: The show is interrupted by too many commercials.
ex.zh: 這個節目被太多廣告打斷了。

commercial.en: a short advertisement shown on television or played on the radio

ex.en: The movie was a huge commercial success.
ex.zh: 這部電影在商業上非常成功。

ex.en: This area is mostly commercial buildings.
ex.zh: 這一區大多是商業大樓。

commercial.en: relating to buying and selling goods to make money

ex.en: His comments about the book were favorable.
ex.zh: 他對這本書的評價很正面。

ex.en: Comments must be relevant to the topic.
ex.zh: 留言必須和主題相關。

ex.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
ex.zh: 我的評論在小組裡引發了爭論。

comment.en: something you say or write that gives your opinion about something

ex.en: The company declined to comment on the rumors.
ex.zh: 公司拒絕對傳言發表評論。

ex.en: Many users commented on her post.
ex.zh: 很多使用者在她的貼文下留言。

comment.en: to say or write what you think about something

ex.en: The first phase of construction has been completed.
ex.zh: 第一階段的工程已經完成了。

ex.en: A new school building is under construction.
ex.zh: 一棟新的教學大樓正在興建中。

ex.en: A new road is under construction.
ex.zh: 一條新的道路正在施工中。

construction.en: the work of building something such as a house, road or bridge

ex.en: He works in construction.
ex.zh: 他在建築業工作。

ex.en: Construction workers start early in the morning.
ex.zh: 工地的工人一大早就開工。

construction.en: the industry of building houses, roads and other large structures

ex.en: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.
ex.zh: 沒有先和我們的承包商討論，我沒辦法算出最後的費用。

ex.en: We hired a contractor to build the new kitchen.
ex.zh: 我們請了包商來做新廚房。

contractor.en: a person or company that agrees to do work or supply goods for another company

ex.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
ex.zh: 他的薪酬包括底薪加佣金。

ex.en: How much is the commission?
ex.zh: 手續費是多少？

commission.en: money paid to a person for selling something, often a percentage of the sale

ex.en: A friend of mine commissioned a well-known artist to paint a portrait of his wife.
ex.zh: 我的一位朋友委託一位知名畫家幫他太太畫肖像。

ex.en: The city commissioned a statue for the park.
ex.zh: 市政府委託製作一座公園雕像。

commission.en: to officially ask someone to make or create something for you

ex.en: The government set up a commission to study the problem.
ex.zh: 政府成立了一個委員會研究這個問題。

ex.en: The commission will publish its report next month.
ex.zh: 委員會下個月將發表報告。

commission.en: an official group of people chosen to find out about something or control it

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 有些海灘沒有遵守環保規定。

ex.en: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
ex.zh: 希望你以後會遵守交通規則。

comply.en: to do what a rule, law or request says you must do

ex.en: He compared the copy with the original.
ex.zh: 他把影本和正本對照了一下。

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the contract.
ex.zh: 請保留一份合約副本。

copy.en: something made to look exactly like another thing

ex.en: Please make three copies of each page.
ex.zh: 每一頁請影印三份。

ex.en: Copy the file to your desktop.
ex.zh: 把檔案複製到你的桌面。

copy.en: to make something that is exactly like another thing

ex.en: His book was published just one month ago, and it has already sold thousands of copies.
ex.zh: 他的書一個月前才出版，就已經賣了好幾千本。

ex.en: Can I borrow your copy of the magazine?
ex.zh: 可以借你那本雜誌嗎？

copy.en: one of many books or newspapers that are printed in the same form

ex.en: Can you please copy me on that email?
ex.zh: 那封郵件可以副本給我嗎？

ex.en: Please copy your manager on the email.
ex.zh: 請把這封信副本給你的主管。

copy.en: to send someone a second version of an email you are sending to another person

ex.en: This information is strictly confidential.
ex.zh: 這份資訊是高度機密。

ex.en: Please keep our conversation confidential.
ex.zh: 請對我們的談話內容保密。

confidential.en: meant to be kept secret and shared only with certain people

ex.en: He used his house as collateral for the loan.
ex.zh: 他用房子作為貸款的擔保品。

ex.en: The bank asked for collateral before approving the loan.
ex.zh: 銀行在核准貸款前要求提供擔保品。

collateral.en: property you promise to give a bank if you cannot pay back a loan

ex.en: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
ex.zh: 日本在高科技產業很有競爭力。

ex.en: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
ex.zh: 為了保持競爭力，我們得發揮我們的優勢。

ex.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
ex.zh: 如果系統工程師繼續離職，公司的競爭優勢就會被削弱。

competitive.en: as good as or better than others, especially in price or quality

ex.en: She is overly competitive.
ex.zh: 她是個任何事情都喜歡和別人一比高下的人。

ex.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
ex.zh: 冰球選手有時好勝心太強，甚至會打起架來。

competitive.en: always wanting to win or to be better than other people

ex.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
ex.zh: 客訴增加可能代表生意在走下坡。

ex.en: If I do not get the item this week, I will make a complaint to PayPal.
ex.zh: 如果這週還收不到貨，我就要向 PayPal 投訴。

ex.en: I do not want to hear your complaints again.
ex.zh: 我不想再聽到你的抱怨了。

complaint.en: a statement that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something

ex.en: Tom has already filed a complaint.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經提出了申訴。

ex.en: You can file a complaint online.
ex.zh: 你可以在網路上提出申訴。

complaint.en: an official statement saying that someone has done something wrong

ex.en: You must compensate him for the money he lost.
ex.zh: 你必須賠償他損失的錢。

ex.en: The airline compensated passengers for the delay.
ex.zh: 航空公司賠償了延誤的旅客。

compensate.en: to pay someone money because they have lost something or been hurt

ex.en: Hard work can compensate for a lack of talent.
ex.zh: 努力可以彌補天分的不足。

ex.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a friend.
ex.zh: 失去朋友是什麼都彌補不了的。

compensate.en: to make a bad thing less bad by having something good to balance it

ex.en: The technician received a commendation for restoring service during the storm.
ex.zh: 這名技術人員因在暴風雨期間迅速恢復服務而獲得表揚。

ex.en: Her commendation from the client was added to her personnel file.
ex.zh: 客戶對她的嘉獎被記錄在她的人事資料中。

commendation.en: an official statement of praise for good work or a brave act

ex.en: The two negotiators spoke cordially despite their different positions.
ex.zh: 兩位談判代表雖然立場不同，交談時仍保持友善。

ex.en: The invitation cordially welcomed partners to the company’s anniversary event.
ex.zh: 這封邀請函誠摯歡迎合作夥伴參加公司的周年活動。

cordially.en: in a warm, friendly and polite way

ex.en: I concur with the committee’s recommendation.
ex.zh: 我同意委員會的建議。

ex.en: The auditors concurred that the figures were accurate.
ex.zh: 稽核人員一致認為數字正確。

concur.en: to have the same opinion as someone else

ex.en: Collective bargaining begins after the new representatives are elected.
ex.zh: 新代表選出後將開始集體協商。

ex.en: The parties reached an agreement through collective bargaining.
ex.zh: 雙方透過集體協商達成協議。

collective bargaining.en: talks between a group of workers and their employer about pay and working conditions

ex.en: The agreement requires strict confidentiality.
ex.zh: 這份協議要求嚴格保密。

ex.en: All staff received training on client confidentiality.
ex.zh: 所有員工都接受了客戶資料保密訓練。

confidentiality.en: the state of keeping information secret from other people

ex.en: The consignee must sign for the shipment.
ex.zh: 收貨人必須簽收這批貨物。

ex.en: Please confirm the consignee's address before dispatch.
ex.zh: 出貨前請確認收貨人的地址。

consignee.en: the person or company that goods are sent to

ex.en: Customs officers seized counterfeit watches at the port.
ex.zh: 海關人員在港口查扣了仿冒手錶。

ex.en: The seller was fined for offering counterfeit goods.
ex.zh: 這名賣家因販售仿冒品而遭到罰款。

counterfeit.en: made to look real in order to trick people, but not real

ex.en: The comptroller approved the revised budget.
ex.zh: 主計長核准了修訂後的預算。

ex.en: Our comptroller reviews all major expenses.
ex.zh: 我們的財務主管會審核所有重大支出。

comptroller.en: a person in charge of checking and managing the money of an organization

ex.en: The cost cutting plan lowered energy use without reducing staff.
ex.zh: 這項降低成本的計畫在不裁員的情況下降低了能源使用量。

ex.en: Managers discussed cost cutting measures after sales fell.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑後，主管討論了降低成本的措施。

cost cutting.en: the act of reducing the money a business spends

ex.en: The company hopes to commercialize the new battery.
ex.zh: 公司希望將這款新電池商品化。

ex.en: Researchers need a partner to commercialize their invention.
ex.zh: 研究人員需要合作夥伴將發明商品化。

commercialize.en: to use something in a way that makes money

ex.en: The device offers reliable connectivity in remote areas.
ex.zh: 這台裝置在偏遠地區也能穩定連線。

ex.en: Poor connectivity interrupted the video meeting.
ex.zh: 連線不穩中斷了視訊會議。

connectivity.en: the ability of a device to join a network such as the internet

ex.en: Availability may vary by region and device compatibility.
ex.zh: 實際供應情形可能因地區和裝置相容性而異。

ex.en: Check software compatibility before installing the update.
ex.zh: 安裝更新前請確認軟體相容性。

compatibility.en: the ability of things, especially machines or programs, to work together

ex.en: GCC is a compiler while Python is an interpreter.
ex.zh: GCC 是編譯器，而 Python 是直譯器。

ex.en: The compiler reported an error in the program.
ex.zh: 編譯器回報程式有錯誤。

compiler.en: a computer program that changes code written by people into a form a computer can run

ex.en: The project requires substantial computational power.
ex.zh: 這項專案需要強大的運算能力。

ex.en: Computational models helped predict demand.
ex.zh: 計算模型協助預測需求。

computational.en: relating to using computers or numbers to work something out

ex.en: The engineer found corrosion on the bridge"s support beams.
ex.zh: 工程師在橋梁支撐梁上發現鏽蝕。

ex.en: A protective coating slows corrosion in coastal buildings.
ex.zh: 防護塗層能減緩海岸建築物的腐蝕。

corrosion.en: damage to metal caused slowly by water, air or chemicals

ex.en: Only the flight crew may enter the cockpit during the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行途中只有機組人員可以進入駕駛艙。

ex.en: The pilot checked the instruments in the cockpit before departure.
ex.zh: 起飛前，飛行員在駕駛艙檢查儀表。

cockpit.en: the part of a plane where the pilot sits

ex.en: The collision damaged both vehicles but caused no injuries.
ex.zh: 這起碰撞造成兩輛車受損，所幸無人受傷。

ex.en: The new deadline creates a collision with the product launch.
ex.zh: 新的期限與產品上市時程相衝突。

collision.en: an accident in which two things hit each other with force

ex.en: Enthusiasm is contagious.
ex.zh: 熱情是會感染他人的。

ex.en: Her enthusiasm for the project was contagious.
ex.zh: 她對這項專案的熱情感染了大家。

contagious.en: able to spread easily from one person to another

ex.en: The table has separate bottles for each condiment.
ex.zh: 桌上每種佐料都分別裝在不同瓶子裡。

ex.en: Mustard is a popular condiment for sandwiches.
ex.zh: 芥末醬是三明治常用的佐料。

condiment.en: a sauce or powder you add to food to give it more taste

ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: Where is the information counter?
ex.zh: 詢問處在哪裡？

ex.en: Please pay at this counter.
ex.zh: 請在這個櫃檯付款。

counter.en: a long flat table where customers are served in a shop, bank or airport

ex.en: Matthew's dog, Rocky, loves to steal cupcakes off the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 馬修的狗洛基喜歡從廚房檯面上偷紙杯蛋糕。

ex.en: Please don't leave dirty dishes on the counter.
ex.zh: 請不要把髒碗盤放在檯面上。

counter.en: a flat surface in a kitchen where food is prepared

ex.en: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
ex.zh: 當計數器的數值達到預設的「幸運號碼」時，就會顯示一則恭喜訊息。

ex.en: The website has a visitor counter at the bottom of the page.
ex.zh: 這個網站的頁面底部有一個訪客計數器。

counter.en: a device or program that keeps a total of how many times something happens

ex.en: I almost missed my connecting flight in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 我差點在香港錯過轉機航班。

ex.en: If your first flight is late, the airline will rebook your connecting flight.
ex.zh: 如果你的第一段航班延誤，航空公司會幫你改訂轉機航班。

connecting flight.en: a plane trip that you take after another one to reach your final place

ex.en: The airline offered us compensation for the long delay.
ex.zh: 航空公司因為長時間延誤而提供我們賠償。

ex.en: You may be entitled to compensation if your flight is canceled.
ex.zh: 如果航班被取消，你可能有權獲得賠償。

compensation.en: money given to someone because they have suffered a loss or problem

ex.en: The job offers good compensation and benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作提供不錯的薪酬和福利。

ex.en: Compensation includes a base salary and an annual bonus.
ex.zh: 薪酬包括底薪和年終獎金。

compensation.en: the money and other benefits paid to a person for their work

ex.en: The concierge recommended a great restaurant nearby.
ex.zh: 禮賓人員推薦了附近一家很棒的餐廳。

ex.en: Ask the concierge to book a taxi for you.
ex.zh: 請禮賓人員幫你叫計程車。

concierge.en: a hotel worker who helps guests with bookings and tips

ex.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。

ex.en: Guests receive a complimentary bottle of water.
ex.zh: 房客會獲贈一瓶免費的水。

ex.en: She made some complimentary remarks about my work.
ex.zh: 她對我的工作說了些讚美的話。

ex.en: The reviews were mostly complimentary.
ex.zh: 評論大多是讚美。

ex.en: The train was packed with commuters.
ex.zh: 火車上擠滿了通勤族。

ex.en: Many commuters read on their phones on the way to work.
ex.zh: 許多通勤族在上班途中用手機閱讀。

commuter.en: a person who travels a long way to work every day

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a big problem in the city center.
ex.zh: 交通壅塞是市中心的大問題。

ex.en: Taking the MRT helps reduce congestion.
ex.zh: 搭捷運有助於減少交通壅塞。

congestion.en: a situation where too many vehicles are on the road and moving slowly

ex.en: This medicine relieves nasal congestion.
ex.zh: 這種藥可以緩解鼻塞。

ex.en: I have a bad cold with a lot of congestion.
ex.zh: 我得了重感冒，鼻塞很嚴重。

congestion.en: a blocked feeling in the nose or chest caused by an illness

ex.en: I have only 40 minutes to make my connection.
ex.zh: 我只有 40 分鐘趕下一班轉乘。

ex.en: We missed our connection in Frankfurt.
ex.zh: 我們在法蘭克福錯過了轉機。

connection.en: a train, bus or plane that you change to during a journey

ex.en: My internet connection was cut off.
ex.zh: 我的網路連線被切斷了。

ex.en: Why is my Internet connection so slow?
ex.zh: 我的網路怎麼這麼慢？

connection.en: a link that lets a device join the internet or a phone line

ex.en: There is no connection between them.
ex.zh: 兩者沒有關聯。

ex.en: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
ex.zh: 科學上還沒有證實血型和性格有關聯。

connection.en: a relationship between two or more things or people

ex.en: Tom is standing in the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 湯姆正站在房間的角落。

ex.en: Who is the man sitting in the corner?
ex.zh: 坐在角落的那個男人是誰？

corner.en: the place where two walls or edges meet

ex.en: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.
ex.zh: 開車時，轉彎處要減速。

ex.en: There's a convenience store on the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角有一家便利商店。

corner.en: the place where two streets meet or where a road turns

ex.en: The teacher confiscated a student's phone because he was texting in class.
ex.zh: 老師沒收了一個學生的手機，因為他上課傳簡訊。

ex.en: The package was confiscated by customs.
ex.zh: 包裹被海關沒收了。

confiscate.en: to officially take something away from someone because of a rule or law

ex.en: Customs officers found contraband in his suitcase.
ex.zh: 海關人員在他的行李箱裡發現違禁品。

ex.en: Smuggling contraband can lead to a long prison sentence.
ex.zh: 走私違禁品可能會被判重刑。

contraband.en: goods that are illegal to bring into or out of a country

ex.en: He got a concussion after falling off his bike.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後腦震盪。

ex.en: Players with a concussion should not return to the game.
ex.zh: 腦震盪的球員不應該回到比賽中。

concussion.en: a brain injury caused by a hit on the head

ex.en: We are working hard to cooperate more.
ex.zh: 我們正在努力加強合作。

ex.en: The two departments need to cooperate on this project.
ex.zh: 兩個部門需要在這個專案上合作。

cooperate.en: to work or act together with other people to reach a goal

ex.en: Our team collaborated with designers in Japan.
ex.zh: 我們的團隊和日本的設計師合作。

ex.en: Students are encouraged to collaborate on group projects.
ex.zh: 學校鼓勵學生在小組專題上合作。

collaborate.en: to work together with other people on a shared piece of work

ex.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
ex.zh: 語言是人們與他人交流的手段。

ex.en: We have to try to communicate with them.
ex.zh: 我們要設法跟他們交流。

ex.en: Can you communicate in English what you want to say?
ex.zh: 你能用英文表達你想說的話嗎？

communicate.en: to share information or feelings with other people

ex.en: Ted was finally able to communicate his thoughts in Japanese.
ex.zh: 泰德終於能用日文表達自己的想法了。

ex.en: The manager communicated the new policy to all staff.
ex.zh: 經理向所有員工傳達了新政策。

communicate.en: to make your ideas or information known to others

ex.en: Your opinion is very constructive.
ex.zh: 你的想法很有建設性。

ex.en: Thank you for the constructive criticism.
ex.zh: 謝謝你有建設性的批評。

constructive.en: useful and helping to make something better

ex.en: There are often border conflicts between these two countries.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家經常發生邊境衝突。

ex.en: This inner conflict tends to diminish as the years go by.
ex.zh: 這種內心的衝突往往會隨著歲月流逝而平息。

ex.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
ex.zh: 這座城市裡黑人和白人之間的衝突越來越嚴重。

conflict.en: a serious disagreement or fight between people or groups

ex.en: The meeting conflicts with my doctor's appointment.
ex.zh: 這場會議和我看醫生的時間衝突。

ex.en: His story conflicts with what the witness said.
ex.zh: 他的說法和證人說的互相牴觸。

conflict.en: to be different from something so that both cannot be true or happen together

ex.en: In the end, we reached a compromise.
ex.zh: 最後我們達成了折衷方案。

ex.en: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
ex.zh: 我們試著和他們找出折衷方案。

ex.en: In our view, we have already made the biggest possible compromise.
ex.zh: 在我們看來，我們已經做出最大的讓步了。

compromise.en: an agreement in which each side gives up some of what it wanted

ex.en: He had refused to compromise on the issue.
ex.zh: 他拒絕在這件事上作出妥協。

ex.en: We tried to compromise with them.
ex.zh: 我們試著和他們妥協。

compromise.en: to agree to accept less than you wanted so that an argument can end

ex.en: The data leak compromised thousands of accounts.
ex.zh: 資料外洩危及了數千個帳號。

ex.en: Don't compromise your health for work.
ex.zh: 別為了工作犧牲健康。

compromise.en: to put something at risk or make it weaker or less safe

ex.en: We need a contingency plan in case the supplier fails.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個應變計畫，以防供應商出問題。

ex.en: The budget includes money for contingencies.
ex.zh: 預算裡包含了應付意外狀況的經費。

contingency.en: something that might happen in the future, or a plan made for it

ex.en: I came to the conclusion that I had been deceived.
ex.zh: 我得出的結論是：我被騙了。

ex.en: How did you arrive at this conclusion?
ex.zh: 你們是怎麼得出這個結論的？

ex.en: Our conclusion is based on previous studies of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們的結論基於之前對這個問題的研究。

conclusion.en: a decision you reach after thinking about all the facts

ex.en: You must not jump to conclusions.
ex.zh: 你不可以妄下結論。

ex.en: Let's not jump to conclusions before we see the data.
ex.zh: 看到資料之前，我們先別妄下結論。

conclusion.en: to decide something too quickly before you know all the facts

ex.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
ex.zh: 他的評論簡潔且擊中要害。

ex.en: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
ex.zh: 兩者都可以，但是前者更簡潔。

concise.en: giving only the important information in a few words

ex.en: The guide gives a comprehensive overview of the city.
ex.zh: 這本指南全面介紹了這座城市。

ex.en: We need a comprehensive plan, not quick fixes.
ex.zh: 我們需要的是全面的計畫，而不是權宜之計。

comprehensive.en: including all or nearly all the things that should be included

ex.en: The building will be completed in a year.
ex.zh: 那棟大樓將在一年內完工。

ex.en: I want this work completed by two o'clock tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 我希望這項工作在明天下午兩點前完成。

ex.en: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要多方合作才能完成。

complete.en: to finish making or doing something

ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
ex.zh: 對我來說，她完全是個陌生人。

ex.en: The man I saw yesterday was a complete gentleman.
ex.zh: 我昨天見到的那個男人是個十足的紳士。

complete.en: used to stress that something is total and has no part missing

ex.en: She coordinates the work of three teams.
ex.zh: 她負責協調三個團隊的工作。

ex.en: We need to coordinate our schedules.
ex.zh: 我們需要協調一下彼此的時間。

coordinate.en: to organize different people or activities so that they work well together

ex.en: A honeymoon in Canada costs a lot of money.
ex.zh: 去加拿大度蜜月要花很多錢。

ex.en: It cost me 5,000 yen to repair my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修腳踏車花了我五千日圓。

ex.en: The concert ticket costs more than the cinema ticket.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票比電影票貴。

cost.en: to need a certain amount of money to be bought or done

ex.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
ex.zh: 問題是, 太陽能太貴了。

ex.en: We need to cut costs this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年需要削減成本。

cost.en: the amount of money you need to pay to buy or do something

ex.en: Bank robbery will cost you ten years in prison.
ex.zh: 搶銀行會讓你坐十年牢。

ex.en: One mistake cost him his job.
ex.zh: 一個錯誤讓他丟了工作。

cost.en: to make someone lose something important

ex.en: The deal is contingent upon the board's approval.
ex.zh: 這筆交易取決於董事會是否核准。

ex.en: Your bonus is contingent on meeting your sales target.
ex.zh: 你的獎金取決於是否達成業績目標。

contingent.en: depending on something else that may or may not happen

ex.en: A large contingent of fans traveled to the final.
ex.zh: 一大批球迷遠道去看決賽。

ex.en: The Taiwanese contingent arrived yesterday.
ex.zh: 台灣代表團昨天抵達。

contingent.en: a group of people sent to represent a larger group or place

ex.en: The consignment of laptops arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 那批筆電今天早上到貨了。

ex.en: Each consignment must have a delivery note.
ex.zh: 每批貨都要附上送貨單。

consignment.en: a quantity of goods that are sent to someone

ex.en: The shop sells second-hand clothes on consignment.
ex.zh: 這家店寄賣二手衣。

ex.en: She left her paintings at the gallery on consignment.
ex.zh: 她把畫作寄放在畫廊寄賣。

consignment.en: an arrangement in which a shop sells your goods and pays you after they are sold

ex.en: The buyer made a counteroffer of 90,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 買方還價九萬美元。

ex.en: We are considering their counteroffer.
ex.zh: 我們正在考慮他們的反提案。

counteroffer.en: a different offer you make after you refuse someone else's first offer

ex.en: This patient's condition is getting worse day by day.
ex.zh: 這病人的情況一天比一天糟。

ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路上的交通狀況正常。

ex.en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
ex.zh: 請寫信告訴我你們學校的狀況。

condition.en: the state that a person or thing is in

ex.en: You can borrow my car on one condition: drive carefully.
ex.zh: 你可以借我的車，但有一個條件：小心開。

ex.en: The loan has strict conditions.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的條件很嚴格。

condition.en: something that must happen or be agreed before something else can happen

ex.en: Both sides made concessions to reach an agreement.
ex.zh: 雙方都做了讓步才達成協議。

ex.en: We are not willing to make any more concessions.
ex.zh: 我們不願意再做任何讓步。

concession.en: something you agree to give or allow in order to end a disagreement

ex.en: Students can get a concession on train tickets.
ex.zh: 學生搭火車可以享有優惠票價。

ex.en: There are concessions for seniors and children.
ex.zh: 長者和兒童有優惠價。

concession.en: a lower price for a particular group of people

ex.en: He conceded that he had made a mistake.
ex.zh: 他承認自己犯了錯。

ex.en: I concede that the plan has some problems.
ex.zh: 我承認這個計畫有些問題。

concede.en: to admit that something is true, although you do not want to

ex.en: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
ex.zh: 英格蘭的守門員因為失球太多而被批評。

ex.en: The company conceded a few points to close the deal.
ex.zh: 公司讓步了幾項條件，才把交易談成。

concede.en: to give up something, or to let the other side score or win

ex.en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.
ex.zh: 我和這家公司簽了三年的合約。

ex.en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
ex.zh: 簽約前你一定要仔細看過合約。

ex.en: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.
ex.zh: 工會和公司談妥了新的合約。

contract.en: a written legal agreement between people or companies

ex.en: He contracted malaria while traveling in Africa.
ex.zh: 他在非洲旅行時感染了瘧疾。

ex.en: Many people contracted the virus last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天很多人感染了這種病毒。

ex.en: Metal contracts when it gets cold.
ex.zh: 金屬遇冷會收縮。

ex.en: The muscles contract when you lift something heavy.
ex.zh: 舉重物時肌肉會收縮。

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 有些海灘沒有遵守環保規定。

ex.en: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
ex.zh: 希望你以後會遵守交通規則。

ex.en: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
ex.zh: 不遵守命名規則會導致解析錯誤。

comply with.en: to do what a rule, law or request says you must do

ex.en: My colleague arranged the work files for me.
ex.zh: 同事幫我整理好了工作檔案。

ex.en: We have a colleague in Australia.
ex.zh: 我們在澳洲有一位同事。

ex.en: Lucy and I are not colleagues, we are classmates.
ex.zh: 我和露西不是同事，是同學。

colleague.en: a person who works with you

ex.en: Tom is waiting for you in the conference room.
ex.zh: 湯姆在會議室等你。

ex.en: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
ex.zh: 請於下午兩點半到二樓會議室開會。

conference room.en: a room in a workplace where meetings are held

ex.en: The board will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 董事會將於下週一召開會議討論預算。

ex.en: The manager convened an emergency meeting.
ex.zh: 經理召開了一場緊急會議。

convene.en: to come together, or to call people together, for a meeting

ex.en: Worrying doesn't take away tomorrow's concerns, but it does take away today's power.
ex.zh: 煩惱帶不走明天的憂慮，卻會帶走今天的力量。

ex.en: I have some concerns about the budget.
ex.zh: 我對預算有些疑慮。

concern.en: a feeling of worry about something

ex.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
ex.zh: 不要干預不關你的事！

ex.en: Tom always meddles in affairs that do not concern him.
ex.zh: 湯姆總是插手跟他無關的事。

concern.en: to be about someone or something, or to affect them

concern.zh: as far as I'm concerned：就我而言

ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, things are going well.
ex.zh: 就我而言，事情進行得很順利。

ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
ex.zh: 對我來說，她完全是個陌生人。

concern.en: used to give your own opinion or to show how something affects you

ex.en: After a long discussion, we finally reached a consensus.
ex.zh: 經過長時間討論，我們終於達成了共識。

ex.en: There is no consensus on how to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 對於如何解決這個問題，大家還沒有共識。

consensus.en: an agreement reached by all the people in a group

ex.en: Please keep all correspondence with the client in this folder.
ex.zh: 請把和客戶往來的信件都放在這個資料夾裡。

ex.en: We have been in correspondence for several months.
ex.zh: 我們已經通信好幾個月了。

correspondence.en: letters or emails that people send to each other

ex.en: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
ex.zh: 我想再確認一下我的航班。

ex.en: We will confirm your order as follows.
ex.zh: 您的訂單確認如下。

confirm.en: to tell someone that a plan or booking is certain

ex.en: The news confirmed my suspicions.
ex.zh: 這個消息證實了我的懷疑。

ex.en: However, all these data were not confirmed.
ex.zh: 不過，這些資料都還沒有得到證實。

confirm.en: to show that something is true

ex.en: The staff were courteous and helpful.
ex.zh: 工作人員有禮貌又樂於幫忙。

ex.en: Please send a courteous reply to the customer.
ex.zh: 請給客戶一個客氣的回覆。

courteous.en: polite and showing respect to other people

ex.en: Your cover letter should explain why you want the job.
ex.zh: 你的求職信應該說明你為什麼想要這份工作。

ex.en: Keep your cover letter to one page.
ex.zh: 求職信控制在一頁以內。

cover letter.en: a letter you send with your job application to explain why you want the job

ex.en: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
ex.zh: 有人說你是個很有能力的人。

ex.en: We need competent leaders.
ex.zh: 我們需要稱職的領導人。

ex.en: They are both very competent judges.
ex.zh: 他們倆都是很稱職的法官。

competent.en: having the skills and knowledge to do something well

ex.en: Her parents were concerned about her health.
ex.zh: 她的父母很擔心她的健康。

ex.en: We are all concerned about the rising prices.
ex.zh: 我們都很擔心物價上漲。

ex.en: All the people concerned must attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 所有相關人員都必須出席會議。

ex.en: As far as I am concerned, this plan is fine.
ex.zh: 就我而言，這個計劃沒問題。

ex.en: What is your favourite colour?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡什麼顏色？

ex.en: The walls are painted a light colour.
ex.zh: 牆壁漆成了淺色。

ex.en: The leaves change colour in autumn.
ex.zh: 葉子在秋天會變色。

ex.en: The children coloured the picture with crayons.
ex.zh: 孩子們用蠟筆為圖畫著色。

ex.en: She coloured her hair brown last week.
ex.zh: 她上週把頭髮染成了棕色。

ex.en: The local councillor visited our school last week.
ex.zh: 當地的議員上週來訪我們學校。

ex.en: She was elected as a town councillor last year.
ex.zh: 她去年當選為鎮議員。

ex.en: A cop stopped the driver for speeding.
ex.zh: 一名警察攔下了超速的駕駛。

ex.en: The cops arrived at the scene within five minutes.
ex.zh: 警察在五分鐘內抵達了現場。

ex.en: They rented a cottage near the lake for the weekend.
ex.zh: 他們租了一間湖邊的小屋度週末。

ex.en: The old cottage has a small garden full of flowers.
ex.zh: 那間老小屋有一座開滿花的小花園。

ex.en: I received a letter concerning my new job.
ex.zh: 我收到一封關於我新工作的信。

ex.en: There are many rules concerning the use of this room.
ex.zh: 關於這個房間的使用有許多規定。

ex.en: The instructions were too complicated for me to follow.
ex.zh: 這份說明太複雜了，我看不懂。

ex.en: It's a complicated problem with no easy answer.
ex.zh: 這是個複雜的問題，沒有簡單的答案。

ex.en: Their relationship is complicated, so it's hard to explain.
ex.zh: 他們的關係很複雜，很難解釋。

ex.en: The classrooms are along a long corridor.
ex.zh: 教室沿著一條長長的走廊排列。

ex.en: Please don't run in the corridor.
ex.zh: 請不要在走廊上奔跑。

ex.en: The doctor's office is at the end of the corridor.
ex.zh: 醫師的診間在走廊盡頭。

ex.en: I am convinced that he is telling the truth.
ex.zh: 我深信他說的是實話。

ex.en: She was convinced she had locked the door.
ex.zh: 她確信自己鎖好門了。

ex.en: They are not convinced by his explanation.
ex.zh: 他們並不相信他的解釋。

ex.en: The old man's dog was his only companion.
ex.zh: 老先生的狗是他唯一的伴。

ex.en: She chose a travel companion for the long trip.
ex.zh: 她為這趟長途旅行挑了一位旅伴。

ex.en: He was a loyal companion during the hard years.
ex.zh: 在艱難的歲月裡，他是一位忠實的夥伴。

ex.en: It took courage to speak in front of the whole school.
ex.zh: 在全校面前發言需要勇氣。

ex.en: She found the courage to apply for her dream job.
ex.zh: 她鼓起勇氣應徵夢想中的工作。

ex.en: A constable stopped to help the lost tourist.
ex.zh: 一位警察停下來幫助迷路的遊客。

ex.en: The village constable knows everyone by name.
ex.zh: 村裡的警察認識每個人的名字。

ex.en: He fell asleep on the couch while watching TV.
ex.zh: 他看電視時在沙發上睡著了。

ex.en: We bought a new couch for the living room.
ex.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張新沙發。

ex.en: She couched her refusal in polite words.
ex.zh: 她用禮貌的措辭來婉拒。

ex.en: The advice was couched as a friendly suggestion.
ex.zh: 這個建議是以友善提議的方式表達的。

ex.en: The colonel gave orders to the soldiers early in the morning.
ex.zh: 上校一大早就對士兵們下達命令。

ex.en: My grandfather retired from the army as a colonel.
ex.zh: 我爺爺以上校軍階從軍中退役。

ex.en: The children drew pictures with brightly coloured pencils.
ex.zh: 孩子們用顏色鮮豔的彩色鉛筆畫圖。

ex.en: She wore a coloured scarf to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條彩色圍巾去參加派對。

ex.en: Lights of different colours coloured the whole street at night.
ex.zh: 夜晚不同顏色的燈光把整條街都染上了色彩。

ex.en: She studied computing at university and now designs software.
ex.zh: 她在大學學計算機科學，現在設計軟體。

ex.en: Cloud computing lets people store files online.
ex.zh: 雲端運算讓人們可以把檔案存在網路上。

ex.en: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations.
ex.zh: 澳洲是大英國協的成員國。

ex.en: The commonwealth was formed by several small states.
ex.zh: 這個聯邦是由幾個小邦組成的。

ex.en: The combined efforts of the team led to success.
ex.zh: 團隊共同的努力帶來了成功。

ex.en: Their combined income is enough to buy a house.
ex.zh: 他們兩人的收入加起來足以買房子。

ex.en: We drove along the coastal road all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午沿著濱海公路開車。

ex.en: Coastal cities are often at risk of flooding.
ex.zh: 沿海城市常有淹水的風險。

ex.en: The courtroom was silent while the judge read the decision.
ex.zh: 法官宣讀判決時，法庭裡一片寂靜。

ex.en: Reporters waited outside the courtroom for the lawyers to come out.
ex.zh: 記者在法庭外等律師出來。

ex.en: The family gathered around the coffin to say goodbye.
ex.zh: 家人圍在棺木旁道別。

ex.en: Flowers were placed on top of the coffin.
ex.zh: 棺木上放了花。

ex.en: He had a guilty conscience after telling the lie.
ex.zh: 他說了謊之後良心不安。

ex.en: My conscience wouldn't let me keep the money I found.
ex.zh: 我的良心不允許我把撿到的錢據為己有。

ex.en: Match each word with its corresponding picture.
ex.zh: 請把每個單字與其對應的圖片配對。

ex.en: Prices rose with a corresponding drop in sales.
ex.zh: 價格上漲，銷量也相應下降。

ex.en: He is a corresponding member of the club.
ex.zh: 他是這個俱樂部的通訊會員。

ex.en: The corresponding secretary answers all the letters.
ex.zh: 通信秘書負責回覆所有的信件。

ex.en: I am busy preparing for the coming exams.
ex.zh: 我正忙著準備即將到來的考試。

ex.en: We are planning a trip for the coming weekend.
ex.zh: 我們正在規劃這個週末的旅行。

ex.en: Everyone was excited about the coming of spring.
ex.zh: 大家都對春天的到來感到興奮。

ex.en: The coming and going of guests kept us busy.
ex.zh: 客人來來去去讓我們忙個不停。

ex.en: I have a confession to make: I ate your cake.
ex.zh: 我要坦白一件事：我吃了你的蛋糕。

ex.en: His confession surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他的坦白讓房間裡的每個人都很驚訝。

ex.en: She goes to confession at the church every month.
ex.zh: 她每個月都會到教堂告解。

ex.en: The priest listened to his confession patiently.
ex.zh: 神父耐心地聽他告解。

ex.en: She decided to try counselling to deal with stress.
ex.zh: 她決定嘗試諮商來處理壓力。

ex.en: The school offers free counselling for students.
ex.zh: 學校為學生提供免費的輔導服務。

compelling.zh: 引人入勝的、有說服力的

ex.en: The author tells a compelling story about growing up.
ex.zh: 作者講述了一個關於成長的引人入勝的故事。

ex.en: She gave a compelling reason for changing the plan.
ex.zh: 她提出了一個有說服力的理由來改變計畫。

convincing.zh: 有說服力的、令人信服的

ex.en: She gave a convincing reason for being late.
ex.zh: 她提出了一個令人信服的遲到理由。

ex.en: The evidence was not convincing enough for the judge.
ex.zh: 這份證據對法官來說不夠有說服力。

ex.en: The nurse treated every patient with kindness and compassion.
ex.zh: 那位護理師以善意與同情心對待每一位病人。

ex.en: He felt great compassion for the lost child.
ex.zh: 他對那個迷路的孩子充滿同情。

ex.en: Teachers need patience and compassion to work with young children.
ex.zh: 老師需要耐心與同理心才能和小孩相處。

ex.en: The whole congregation stood up and sang together.
ex.zh: 全體會眾一起站起來唱歌。

ex.en: Our congregation has grown a lot in the past five years.
ex.zh: 我們的會眾在過去五年成長了很多。

ex.en: A large congregation of birds gathered by the lake.
ex.zh: 一大群鳥聚集在湖邊。

ex.en: The congregation of fans outside the stadium blocked the road.
ex.zh: 體育場外聚集的球迷擋住了道路。

ex.en: When I was five, I could already ride a bike.
ex.zh: 我五歲的時候就已經會騎腳踏車了。

ex.en: She could not open the door because it was locked.
ex.zh: 門鎖住了，所以她打不開。

ex.en: It could rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

ex.en: That could be the reason he is late.
ex.zh: 那也許就是他遲到的原因。

could.zh: 可以…嗎（客氣的請求：Could you help me?）

ex.en: Could you help me carry this box?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？

ex.en: Could I borrow your pen for a moment?
ex.zh: 我可以借一下你的筆嗎？

ex.en: The bill was debated in the House of Commons for several days.
ex.zh: 這項法案在下議院辯論了好幾天。

ex.en: Members of the Commons voted on the new law late at night.
ex.zh: 下議院議員在深夜對新法律進行了表決。

ex.en: Colin cooks dinner for his family every Sunday.
ex.zh: 柯林每個星期天都會為家人煮晚餐。

ex.en: Colin showed us the way to the museum.
ex.zh: 柯林帶我們走到博物館。

continued.zh: 繼續（continue 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She continued working even though she was tired.
ex.zh: 即使累了，她還是繼續工作。

ex.en: The rain continued all night long.
